患者登革热IgM检测呈阳性,伴有血小板减少(104,000/mm3)和肝酶升高。影像学检查确认了肝静脉血栓形成、下腔静脉狭窄和尾状叶增大,确立了诊断与布-奇亚里综合征的关联。血栓形成倾向筛查显示蛋白C、蛋白S和抗凝血酶III缺乏。患者还出现了严重的双下肢疼痛,神经传导研究证实了双下肢的感觉性多发性神经病。 [10.4103/aam.aam_503_26]
ZIKV 感染产生持续的 NS1 反应,而原发性 DENV 感染表现出最小的 ZIKV 交叉反应性,继发性 DENV 感染仅表现出短暂的、低水平的增加。 [10.64898/2026.09.04.26362297]
在260名参与者中,78名(30.0%)检测出登革热血清学阳性,182名(70.0%)检测为阴性。发热是最常见的症状,有157名(60.38%)参与者报告了发热。大多数参与者未住院,229名(88.08%),248名(95.38%)存活,记录到12名(4.62%)死亡。 [10.12688/openresafrica.16780.1]
PG在剂量和时间依赖性实验中显著抑制了蚊虫细胞中的登革病毒感染,并显著降低了成年Ae. albopictus中的DENV2 RNA水平。机制研究显示,PG诱导ER应激并上调GRP78,从而引发自噬通量。PG还促进了自噬体与溶酶体的融合,导致病毒被清除。 [10.1080/21505594.2026.2721757]

key_findings_en: Seventy percent of children had severe dengue shock at admission, and 58.8% had multiorgan dysfunction. Modifiable factors were identified in 82.4% of the cases, including delayed recognition of compensated shock and fluid management issues. [10.1007/s12098-026-06434-z]

The patient tested positive for dengue IgM with thrombocytopenia (104,000/mm3) and elevated liver enzymes. Imaging studies confirmed hepatic vein thrombosis, inferior vena cava narrowing, and caudate lobe hypertrophy, establishing the diagnosis of BCS. [10.4103/aam.aam_503_26]

ZIKV infections produced sustained NS1 responses, whereas primary DENV infections showed minimal ZIKV cross-reactivity and secondary DENV infections exhibited only transient, low-level increases. [10.64898/2026.09.04.26362297]

Of the 260 participants, 78 (30.0%) tested positive for dengue serology and 182 (70.0%) tested negative. Fever was the most common symptom, reported by 157 (60.38%) participants. Most participants were not admitted to hospital, 229 (88.08%), and 248 (95.38%) survived, while 12 (4.62%) deaths were recorded. [10.12688/openresafrica.16780.1]

PG treatment suppressed dengue virus infection in mosquito cells in a dose- and time-dependent manner and significantly reduced DENV2 RNA levels in adult Ae. Mechanistic investigations revealed that PG induces ER stress and upregulates GRP78, leading to autophagic flux. [10.1080/21505594.2026.2721757]

news.lead_zh: 本期登革病毒新闻集中呈现以下动态。
key_findings_zh: 世卫组织举办名为"Shastho Chorcha"的对话,以强调在登革热应对中采取政府与社会整体行动。这是世界卫生组织的官方声明。 [news-a459e551765b40c5]
The World Health Organization (WHO) has identified six dengue drug candidates with evidence warranting further development, with only VIS513 reaching Phase 3 trials. [news-fba881e83792f3a0]
菲律宾卫生部记录了2026年8月2日至15日的15,763例登革热病例,比前一个两周时期(2026年7月19日至8月1日)增加了9%。 [news-f53ad522c85c7218]
佛罗里达州正经历登革热病例激增,佛罗里达州卫生部尚未确认诊断及死亡病例,但这种情况似乎预示着该州可能面临严峻的公共卫生挑战。该事件由坦帕湾时报和Jezebel报道,盖伊·斯莫尔这位80岁女性的死亡被怀疑为本地传播病例。 [news-3060a817cd47766d]

A dengue outbreak is ongoing in Bangladesh, with 1,571 new cases and nine deaths reported in the 24 hours to 08 September 2026, making it the highest single-day figures this year. [news-da8b693cdaa77434]

papers.title: Structural biology of the dengue virus NS2B-NS3 protease as a target for antiviral drug development.
papers.abstract: Dengue is the most common global problem in recent times, particularly in tropical and subtropical areas, yet antivirals for therapy or prophylaxis are lacking. Millions of people are affected by this dengue virus, but no proper medication is available yet to cure this disease. One polyprotein that is encoded by the DENV genome is converted into structural and non-structural proteins that are necessary for viral pathogenesis and replication. Among these, the non-structural protein complex NS2B-NS3 is essential for viral polyprotein processing, replication, and host innate immune response control. It acts as a trypsin-like serine protease. The NS2B/NS3 protease is a key enzyme involved in viral replication and serves as a major target for drug development against the dengue virus. The NS3 protease has a conserved catalytic triad (His-Asp-Ser), whereas NS2B serves as an essential cofactor that stabilizes the active conformation of the enzyme and aids in substrate recognition. By disrupting interferon signalling pathways, the NS2B-NS3 protease not only aids in viral replication but also makes immune evasion easier. The compound that inhibits the action of this enzyme could be pioneering in the antiviral drug discovery process. This article provides a comprehensive overview of the detailed structural information of the viral protease (NS2B/NS3) enzyme with the mechanistic role of this enzyme, and highlights various inhibitors related to the NS2B/NS3 protease. A more thorough comprehension of this protease could facilitate the logical development of potent antiviral medications to prevent dengue infection.

papers.title_original: Structural biology of the dengue virus NS2B-NS3 protease as a target for antiviral drug development.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review focuses on the structural biology of the dengue virus NS2B-NS3 protease, specifically its role in viral replication and as a target for antiviral drug development. The central question is how understanding the protease's structure and function can aid in creating effective antiviral therapies for dengue infection.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is a comprehensive analysis of the structural and functional aspects of the NS2B-NS3 protease in the dengue virus. It does not report on specific databases, search dates, or eligibility criteria for studies. The review is primarily narrative, summarizing existing knowledge without detailing a meta-analysis or consensus process.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The NS2B-NS3 protease is a critical enzyme for dengue virus replication and is essential for processing the viral polyprotein. It functions as a trypsin-like serine protease and plays a key role in modulating the host innate immune response. The protease's conserved catalytic triad (His-Asp-Ser) and the role of NS2B as a cofactor in stabilizing its active conformation are well-established. Inhibitors targeting this protease are considered promising for antiviral drug discovery.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review highlights that while the NS2B-NS3 protease is a key target for drug development, there is limited information on the specific mechanisms of immune evasion and the precise role of the protease in different dengue virus serotypes. Additionally, the review does not address the potential for cross-serotype inhibition or the effectiveness of inhibitors in vivo.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: Further research is needed to explore the structural variations of the NS2B-NS3 protease across dengue virus serotypes and to develop inhibitors that are effective against all serotypes. There is also a need for in vivo studies to evaluate the efficacy and safety of potential antiviral compounds targeting this protease. Additionally, understanding the protease's role in immune evasion could lead to more targeted therapeutic strategies.

analysis.summary_en: This review provides an in-depth analysis of the structural biology of the dengue virus NS2B-NS3 protease, emphasizing its critical role in viral replication and immune evasion. The protease is described as a trypsin-like serine protease with a conserved catalytic triad, and NS2B is noted as an essential cofactor. The review highlights the potential of inhibitors targeting this protease for antiviral drug development, though it notes gaps in understanding the protease's role across different serotypes and in vivo efficacy. The implications suggest a need for further research into structural variations and the development of broad-spectrum inhibitors.

elements_en.scope_and_question: The review focuses on the structural biology of the dengue virus NS2B-NS3 protease, specifically its role in viral replication and as a target for antiviral drug development. The central question is how understanding the protease's structure and function can aid in creating effective antiviral therapies for dengue infection.
elements_en.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is a comprehensive analysis of the structural and functional aspects of the NS2B-NS3 protease in the dengue virus. It does not report on specific databases, search dates, or eligibility criteria for studies. The review is primarily narrative, summarizing existing knowledge without detailing a meta-analysis or consensus process.
elements_en.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The NS2B-NS3 protease is a critical enzyme for dengue virus replication and is essential for processing the viral polyprotein. It functions as a trypsin-like serine protease and plays a key role in modulating the host innate immune response. The protease's conserved catalytic triad (His-Asp-Ser) and the role of NS2B as a cofactor in stabilizing its active conformation are well-established. Inhibitors targeting this protease are considered promising for antiviral drug discovery.
elements_en.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review highlights that while the NS2B-NS3 protease is a key target for drug development, there is limited information on the specific mechanisms of immune evasion and the precise role of the protease in different dengue virus serotypes. Additionally, the review does not address the potential for cross-serotype inhibition or the effectiveness of inhibitors in vivo.
elements_en.research_and_practice_implications: Further research is needed to explore the structural variations of the NS2B-NS3 protease across dengue virus serotypes and to develop inhibitors that are effective against all serotypes. There is also a need for in vivo studies to evaluate the efficacy and safety of potential antiviral compounds targeting this protease. Additionally, understanding the protease's role in immune evasion could lead to more targeted therapeutic strategies.

elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该综述是对 登革病毒 中 NS2B-NS3 蛋白酶的结构和功能方面的全面分析。它不报告特定数据库、检索日期或研究资格标准。该评论主要是叙述性的,总结现有的知识,没有详细说明荟萃分析或共识过程。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: NS2B-NS3 蛋白酶是 登革病毒 复制的关键酶,对于加工病毒多蛋白至关重要。它作为胰蛋白酶样丝氨酸蛋白酶发挥作用,并在调节 宿主 固有 免疫应答 中发挥关键作用。该蛋白酶的保守催化三联体 (His-Asp-Ser) 以及 NS2B 作为辅助因子在稳定其活性构象方面的作用已得到充分证实。针对这种蛋白酶的抑制剂被认为有望用于 抗病毒药物 药物发现。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 该综述强调,虽然 NS2B-NS3 蛋白酶是药物开发的关键靶点,但有关免疫逃避的具体机制以及蛋白酶在不同 登革病毒 血清型中的精确作用的信息有限。此外,该综述并未涉及跨血清型抑制的潜力或体内抑制剂的有效性。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 需要进一步的研究来探索 NS2B-NS3 蛋白酶在 登革病毒 血清型之间的结构变异,并开发对所有血清型有效的抑制剂。还需要进行体内研究来评估针对该蛋白酶的潜在 抗病毒药物 化合物的功效和安全性。此外,了解蛋白酶在免疫逃避中的作用可能会导致更有针对性的治疗策略。

papers.title_zh: 作为 抗病毒药物 药物开发靶标的 登革病毒 NS2B-NS3 蛋白酶的结构生物学。
papers.source_body_en: Dengue is the most common global problem in recent times, particularly in tropical and subtropical areas, yet antivirals for therapy or prophylaxis are lacking. Millions of people are affected by this dengue virus, but no proper medication is available yet to cure this disease. One polyprotein that is encoded by the DENV genome is converted into structural and non-structural proteins that are necessary for viral pathogenesis and replication. Among these, the non-structural protein complex NS2B-NS3 is essential for viral polyprotein processing, replication, and host innate immune response control. It acts as a trypsin-like serine protease. The NS2B/NS3 protease is a key enzyme involved in viral replication and serves as a major target for drug development against the dengue virus. The NS3 protease has a conserved catalytic triad (His-Asp-Ser), whereas NS2B serves as an essential cofactor that stabilizes the active conformation of the enzyme and aids in substrate recognition. By disrupting interferon signalling pathways, the NS2B-NS3 protease not only aids in viral replication but also makes immune evasion easier. The compound that inhibits the action of this enzyme could be pioneering in the antiviral drug discovery process. This article provides a comprehensive overview of the detailed structural information of the viral protease (NS2B/NS3) enzyme with the mechanistic role of this enzyme, and highlights various inhibitors related to the NS2B/NS3 protease. A more thorough comprehension of this protease could facilitate the logical development of potent antiviral medications to prevent dengue infection.

papers.title: The varying neuroradiological manifestations of pediatric dengue central nervous system infection: a pictorial review from Pakistan with literature correlation.
papers.abstract: Dengue infection is an increasingly recognized cause of neurological complications in children, with a wide and evolving spectrum of central and peripheral nervous system involvement. This pictorial review systematically illustrates the neuroradiological manifestations of pediatric dengue using a pathophysiology- and imaging pattern-based approach, correlating characteristic magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) findings with the current literature. Neuroimaging manifestations are broadly categorized into direct viral neuroinvasive, immune-mediated, and reversible edema patterns. Direct viral involvement includes meningoencephalitis, deep gray matter involvement, and rhombencephalitis, with severe cases demonstrating the characteristic "double doughnut" sign of necrotizing encephalopathy-like encephalitis and the "Jack-o'-lantern" sign of pontine involvement. Immune-mediated white matter injury includes acute leukoencephalopathy with restricted diffusion and acute disseminated encephalomyelitis, which differ in their diffusion characteristics and temporal relationship to infection. Reversible edema syndromes include reversible splenial lesion syndrome and the less commonly reported posterior reversible encephalopathy syndrome, both associated with favorable clinical and radiological outcomes. Spinal and peripheral nervous system manifestations include myelitis and Guillain-Barré syndrome, with MRI playing a key role in differentiating these entities from other infectious and inflammatory myeloradiculopathies. Importantly, intralesional hemorrhagic changes on susceptibility-weighted or gradient recalled echo imaging, particularly within the deep gray nuclei and brainstem, represent a valuable imaging marker favoring dengue over several viral and inflammatory mimickers. Recognition of these characteristic pattern-based neuroradiological manifestations and their underlying pathophysiological correlates improves diagnostic confidence, facilitates differentiation from competing diagnoses, and guides timely management of pediatric dengue neurological disease in endemic regions.

papers.title_zh: 小儿登革热中枢神经系统感染的不同神经放射学表现:来自巴基斯坦的图片回顾与文献相关性。
papers.source_body_en: Dengue infection is an increasingly recognized cause of neurological complications in children, with a wide and evolving spectrum of central and peripheral nervous system involvement. This pictorial review systematically illustrates the neuroradiological manifestations of pediatric dengue using a pathophysiology- and imaging pattern-based approach, correlating characteristic magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) findings with the current literature. Neuroimaging manifestations are broadly categorized into direct viral neuroinvasive, immune-mediated, and reversible edema patterns. Direct viral involvement includes meningoencephalitis, deep gray matter involvement, and rhombencephalitis, with severe cases demonstrating the characteristic "double doughnut" sign of necrotizing encephalopathy-like encephalitis and the "Jack-o'-lantern" sign of pontine involvement. Immune-mediated white matter injury includes acute leukoencephalopathy with restricted diffusion and acute disseminated encephalomyelitis, which differ in their diffusion characteristics and temporal relationship to infection. Reversible edema syndromes include reversible splenial lesion syndrome and the less commonly reported posterior reversible encephalopathy syndrome, both associated with favorable clinical and radiological outcomes. Spinal and peripheral nervous system manifestations include myelitis and Guillain-Barré syndrome, with MRI playing a key role in differentiating these entities from other infectious and inflammatory myeloradiculopathies. Importantly, intralesional hemorrhagic changes on susceptibility-weighted or gradient recalled echo imaging, particularly within the deep gray nuclei and brainstem, represent a valuable imaging marker favoring dengue over several viral and inflammatory mimickers. Recognition of these characteristic pattern-based neuroradiological manifestations and their underlying pathophysiological correlates improves diagnostic confidence, facilitates differentiation from competing diagnoses, and guides timely management of pediatric dengue neurological disease in endemic regions.
papers.abstract_zh: 登革热感染是儿童神经系统并发症的一个日益被认识的原因,其累及中枢和周围神经系统的范围广泛且不断演变。这篇图片综述使用基于病理生理学和成像模式的方法系统地说明了儿科登革热的神经放射学表现,并将特征性磁共振成像 (MRI) 结果与当前文献相关联。神经影像学表现大致分为直接病毒神经侵袭性、免疫介导性和可逆性水肿模式。病毒直接累及包括脑膜脑炎、深部灰质累及和菱形脑炎,严重病例表现出坏死性脑病样脑炎的特征性“双甜甜圈”征象和脑桥受累的“南瓜灯”征象。免疫介导的白质损伤包括扩散受限的急性白质脑病和急性播散性脑脊髓炎,它们的扩散特征和与感染的时间关系不同。可逆性水肿综合征包括可逆性压部病变综合征和较少报道的可逆性后部脑病综合征,两者都与良好的临床和放射学结果相关。脊髓和周围神经系统表现包括脊髓炎和吉兰-巴利综合征,MRI 在区分这些实体与其他感染性和炎症性脊髓神经根病方面发挥着关键作用。重要的是,磁敏感加权或梯度回忆回波成像的病灶内出血性变化,特别是在深灰核和脑干内,代表了一种有价值的成像标记,有利于登革热而不是几种病毒和炎症模拟物。识别这些基于特征模式的神经放射学表现及其潜在的病理生理学相关性可以提高诊断信心,促进与竞争性诊断的区分,并指导流行地区儿科登革热神经系统疾病的及时管理。

papers.title: Applying a multiplex electrochemiluminescence NS1 assay to detect and differentiate Zika and dengue virus exposures in long-term community cohorts in Brazil and Thailand
papers.abstract: Background: Distinguishing Zika virus (ZIKV) from dengue virus (DENV) infection remains a major diagnostic challenge in co-endemic regions due to antigenic cross-reactivity. We evaluated a multiplex electrochemiluminescence Meso Scale Discovery System (MSD) NS1 assay to define ZIKV infection with high specificity across diverse immune backgrounds. Methods: We analyzed longitudinal samples from PCR-confirmed ZIKV and DENV infections across multiple cohorts, assessed correlations between MSD NS1 signal intensities and PRNT50 titres, and performed ROC analyses to derive seroconversion thresholds. We then applied these criteria to identify ZIKV seroconversions in Brazil (2015-2024) and Thailand (2015-2025). Findings: ZIKV infections produced sustained NS1 responses, whereas primary DENV infections showed minimal ZIKV cross-reactivity and secondary DENV infections exhibited only transient, low-level increases. MSD NS1 signal intensities correlated with PRNT50 titres for ZIKV and all four DENV serotypes (rho = 0.54-0.84). ROC analyses identified a fold-change of at least 10.96 as the optimal ZIKV seroconversion cutoff, with an AUC of 100% among DENV-naive and 90.7% among DENV-exposed participants. Adding a second criterion - ZIKV/DENV fold-change ratio > 1 - further increased specificity. Application of this dual-threshold framework revealed high ZIKV incidence during the 2015-2016 epidemic in Brazil and very low incidence in the post-epidemic period. In the Thailand cohort, synchronous seroconversion among household members suggested potential intra-household transmission. Interpretation: The MSD NS1 multiplex assay provides a scalable, quantitative, and highly specific approach for identifying ZIKV infection and estimating seroincidence in co-endemic settings. The dual-threshold framework (fold-change of at least 10.96 and ZIKV/DENV ratio > 1) enhances diagnostic precision, offering a robust tool for surveillance and transmission studies in flavivirus-endemic regions.

analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to address the diagnostic challenge of distinguishing Zika virus (ZIKV) from dengue virus (DENV) infections in co-endemic regions. The researchers evaluated a multiplex electrochemiluminescence assay to define ZIKV infection with high specificity across diverse immune backgrounds. They analyzed longitudinal samples from PCR-confirmed ZIKV and DENV infections in Brazil and Thailand, correlating MSD NS1 signal intensities with PRNT50 titres and performing ROC analyses to establish seroconversion thresholds. The dual-threshold framework revealed high ZIKV incidence during the 2015-2016 epidemic in Brazil and very low incidence in the post-epidemic period. The study suggests that this assay could be a valuable tool for surveillance and transmission studies in flavivirus-endemic regions. However, the evidence is limited to the specific context of ZIKV and DENV, and the results may not be generalizable to other flaviviruses.

papers.title: Evaluating the Suitability of Dengue Viraemia as a Surrogate Efficacy Outcome for Phase III Trials of Dengue Antivirals: A Systematic Review
papers.abstract: Abstract Background: Dengue cases reached record levels in 2024 alongside geographic expansion into Europe and Africa. The low rate of progression to severe dengue presents a challenge for powering phase III dengue antiviral trials. Viraemia is used as a virological outcome in phase II trials, but whether treatment-induced reductions reliably predict clinical benefit remains uncertain. This systematic review assessed the association between dengue viraemia and disease severity and its suitability as a surrogate efficacy outcome for phase III antiviral trials. Methods: We searched Ovid MEDLINE, Ovid Embase, Scopus, and Web of Science on 20 June 2025 for studies indexed since 2017, extending a previous systematic review. We included clinical studies of laboratory-confirmed dengue measuring quantitative serum viral load by RT-PCR at enrolment and at least one subsequent timepoint and reporting severe dengue as a clinical outcome. The review was registered with PROSPERO (CRD420251077148) and followed PRISMA 2020 reporting guidelines. Results: We screened 3303 records and reviewed 60 full texts; 11 studies met the inclusion criteria, comprising predominantly hospitalised paediatric and younger adult cohorts from the Asia-Pacific. Seven studies reported higher early viraemia (typically during illness days 1– 5) in patients with more severe disease, whereas three found no significant association and one provided insufficient evidence. Two studies assessing viraemia kinetics found that faster viral clearance was associated with lower risk of severe dengue. Heterogeneity in sampling timing, severity classification, and adjustment for host and viral factors limited interpretation. Certainty of evidence was very low. Conclusions: Evidence for an association between dengue viraemia and disease severity was inconsistent and limited by methodological heterogeneity. Most studies assessed severity around the time of hospital admission and could not establish if viraemia predicted subsequent progression from non-severe to severe disease. None were designed to determine whether treatment-induced reductions in viraemia translate into clinical benefit. Dengue viraemia should therefore be regarded as a pharmacodynamic biomarker and supportive virological outcome for early-phase antiviral development, rather than as a validated surrogate efficacy outcome for phase III trials, for which clinically meaningful patient-centred outcomes remain necessary.

analysis.summary_en: This systematic review evaluates the suitability of dengue viraemia as a surrogate efficacy outcome for phase III trials of dengue antivirals. The review included 11 studies, primarily focusing on hospitalised paediatric and younger adult cohorts from the Asia-Pacific, measuring quantitative serum viral load by RT-PCR and reporting severe dengue as a clinical outcome. Seven studies found higher early viraemia in patients with more severe disease, while three found no significant association and one provided insufficient evidence. Two studies assessing viraemia kinetics found that faster viral clearance was associated with lower risk of severe dengue. However, the evidence for an association between viraemia and disease severity was inconsistent, with very low certainty due to methodological heterogeneity. The review highlights that viraemia is not a validated surrogate outcome for phase III trials, as none of the studies were designed to assess whether treatment-induced reductions in viraemia translate into clinical benefit. Instead, viraemia is recommended as a pharmacodynamic biomarker and supportive virological outcome for early-phase development.

papers.title_zh: 评估登革热病毒血症作为登革热 抗病毒药物 III 期试验替代疗效结果的适用性:系统评价
papers.source_body_en: Abstract Background: Dengue cases reached record levels in 2024 alongside geographic expansion into Europe and Africa. The low rate of progression to severe dengue presents a challenge for powering phase III dengue antiviral trials. Viraemia is used as a virological outcome in phase II trials, but whether treatment-induced reductions reliably predict clinical benefit remains uncertain. This systematic review assessed the association between dengue viraemia and disease severity and its suitability as a surrogate efficacy outcome for phase III antiviral trials. Methods: We searched Ovid MEDLINE, Ovid Embase, Scopus, and Web of Science on 20 June 2025 for studies indexed since 2017, extending a previous systematic review. We included clinical studies of laboratory-confirmed dengue measuring quantitative serum viral load by RT-PCR at enrolment and at least one subsequent timepoint and reporting severe dengue as a clinical outcome. The review was registered with PROSPERO (CRD420251077148) and followed PRISMA 2020 reporting guidelines. Results: We screened 3303 records and reviewed 60 full texts; 11 studies met the inclusion criteria, comprising predominantly hospitalised paediatric and younger adult cohorts from the Asia-Pacific. Seven studies reported higher early viraemia (typically during illness days 1– 5) in patients with more severe disease, whereas three found no significant association and one provided insufficient evidence. Two studies assessing viraemia kinetics found that faster viral clearance was associated with lower risk of severe dengue. Heterogeneity in sampling timing, severity classification, and adjustment for host and viral factors limited interpretation. Certainty of evidence was very low. Conclusions: Evidence for an association between dengue viraemia and disease severity was inconsistent and limited by methodological heterogeneity. Most studies assessed severity around the time of hospital admission and could not establish if viraemia predicted subsequent progression from non-severe to severe disease. None were designed to determine whether treatment-induced reductions in viraemia translate into clinical benefit. Dengue viraemia should therefore be regarded as a pharmacodynamic biomarker and supportive virological outcome for early-phase antiviral development, rather than as a validated surrogate efficacy outcome for phase III trials, for which clinically meaningful patient-centred outcomes remain necessary.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要背景:随着地域扩张到欧洲和非洲,登革热病例在 2024 年达到创纪录水平。重症登革热 的低进展率对登革热 III 期 抗病毒药物 试验的支持提出了挑战。病毒血症在 II 期试验中被用作病毒学结果,但 治疗 诱导的减少是否可靠地预测临床益处仍不确定。这项系统评价评估了登革热病毒血症与疾病严重程度之间的关联及其作为 III 期 抗病毒药物 试验的替代疗效结果的适用性。方法:我们于 2025 年 6 月 20 日检索了 Ovid MEDLINE、Ovid Embase、Scopus 和 Web of Science,查找自 2017 年以来编入索引的研究,扩展了之前的系统评价。我们纳入了实验室确诊的登革热临床研究,在入组时和至少一个后续时间点通过 RT-PCR 测量定量血清病毒载量,并报告 重症登革热 作为临床结果。该审查已在 PROSPERO 注册 (CRD420251077148),并遵循 PRISMA 2020 报告指南。结果:筛选3303条记录,审阅全文60篇;11 项研究符合纳入标准,主要包括来自亚太地区的住院儿童和年轻成人 队列研究。七项研究报告称,病情较严重的患者早期病毒血症(通常在患病第 1-5 天期间)较高,而三项研究发现没有显着关联,一项研究提供的证据不足。两项评估病毒血症动力学的研究发现,病毒清除速度越快,重症登革热 风险越低。采样时间、严重程度分类以及 宿主 和病毒因素调整的异质性限制了解释。证据的质量非常低。结论:登革热病毒血症与疾病严重程度之间相关性的证据不一致,并且受到方法学异质性的限制。大多数研究在入院时评估严重程度,无法确定病毒血症是否可以预测随后从非严重疾病进展为严重疾病。没有一个旨在确定 治疗 诱导的病毒血症减少是否转化为临床益处。因此,登革热病毒血症应被视为早期 抗病毒药物 开发的药效生物标志物和支持性病毒学结果,而不是作为 III 期试验的经过验证的替代疗效结果,因为 III 期试验仍需要具有临床意义的以患者为中心的结果。

papers.title: Beyond Hemorrhage: A Case of Acute Dengue Infection Presenting with Budd-Chiari Syndrome and Bilateral Sensory Polyneuropathy.
papers.abstract: Abstract Budd–Chiari syndrome (BCS) is a rare hepatic vascular disorder characterized by hepatic venous outflow obstruction with an incidence of 1–2 per million population annually. While dengue fever is primarily associated with hemorrhagic complications, thrombotic events are rarely reported. To our knowledge, this represents the first documented case of BCS occurring in association with dengue fever. A 22-year-old male from a rural area presented with a 4-day history of abdominal pain, fever, vomiting, and loose stools. Physical examination revealed hepatomegaly, ascites, and mild dehydration. Laboratory investigations confirmed dengue IgM positivity with thrombocytopenia (104,000/mm 3 ) and elevated liver enzymes. Thrombophilia screening revealed deficiencies in protein C, protein S, and antithrombin III. Imaging studies, including ultrasonography, computed tomography with contrast, and color Doppler, demonstrated hepatic vein thrombosis, inferior vena cava narrowing, and caudate lobe hypertrophy, establishing the diagnosis of BCS. Upper gastrointestinal endoscopy revealed grade II esophageal varices consistent with portal hypertension. During admission, the patient also developed severe bilateral lower limb pain refractory to strong analgesics, and nerve conduction studies confirmed sensory polyneuropathy in both lower limbs. The patient was managed with supportive care and careful anticoagulation therapy using low-molecular-weight heparin (LMWH), followed by warfarin 4 mg daily. Despite initial thrombocytopenia, anticoagulation was successfully initiated with close monitoring for bleeding complications. The patient showed an excellent clinical response, with complete resolution of hepatic vein thrombosis, normalization of liver function, and resolution of ascites at follow-up. At 6-month follow-up, repeat thrombophilia assays performed after stopping warfarin and bridging with LMWH revealed normal levels of protein C, protein S, and antithrombin III, indicating no true inherited deficiency. This case highlights a novel association between dengue fever, BCS, and sensory polyneuropathy in a patient with apparent but transient thrombophilia. Early recognition, appropriate anticoagulation, and careful neurological evaluation can lead to favorable outcomes despite concurrent thrombocytopenia.

To our knowledge, this represents the first documented case of BCS occurring in association with dengue fever. A 22-year-old male from a rural area presented with a 4-day history of abdominal pain, fever, vomiting, and loose stools. Physical examination revealed hepatomegaly, ascites, and mild dehydration. Laboratory investigations confirmed dengue IgM positivity with thrombocytopenia (104,000/mm 3 ) and elevated liver enzymes. Thrombophilia screening revealed deficiencies in protein C, protein S, and antithrombin III. Imaging studies, including ultrasonography, computed tomography with contrast, and color Doppler, demonstrated hepatic vein thrombosis, inferior vena cava narrowing, and caudate lobe hypertrophy, establishing the diagnosis of BCS. Upper gastrointestinal endoscopy revealed grade II esophageal varices consistent with portal hypertension. During admission, the patient also developed severe bilateral lower limb pain refractory to strong analgesics, and nerve conduction studies confirmed sensory polyneuropathy in both lower limbs. The patient was managed with supportive care and careful anticoagulation therapy using low-molecular-weight heparin (LMWH), followed by warfarin 4 mg daily. Despite initial thrombocytopenia, anticoagulation was successfully initiated with close monitoring for bleeding complications. The patient showed an excellent clinical response, with complete resolution of hepatic vein thrombosis, normalization of liver function, and resolution of ascites at follow-up. At 6-month follow-up, repeat thrombophilia assays performed after stopping warfarin and bridging with LMWH revealed normal levels of protein C, protein S, and antithrombin III, indicating no true inherited deficiency. This case highlights a novel association between dengue fever, BCS, and sensory polyneuropathy in a patient with apparent but transient thrombophilia. Early recognition, appropriate anticoagulation, and careful neurological evaluation can lead to favorable outcomes despite concurrent thrombocytopenia.

analysis.summary_en: This case report describes a rare and novel association between dengue fever and Budd-Chiari syndrome (BCS) with bilateral sensory polyneuropathy in a 22-year-old male. The patient presented with acute dengue infection, characterized by fever, vomiting, and abdominal pain, and developed signs of BCS, including hepatomegaly, ascites, and hepatic vein thrombosis. Thrombophilia screening revealed deficiencies in protein C, protein S, and antithrombin III, which resolved after anticoagulation therapy. The case highlights the importance of recognizing atypical presentations of dengue infection, particularly the co-occurrence of BCS and sensory polyneuropathy. The findings suggest that early recognition and appropriate management, including anticoagulation, can lead to favorable outcomes despite concurrent thrombocytopenia. This case adds to the understanding of dengue's diverse clinical manifestations and underscores the need for careful neurological evaluation in dengue patients.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在记录一种罕见且新颖的关联,即登革热与布-奇亚里综合征(BCS)及双侧感觉性多发性神经病之间的联系,强调识别登革病毒感染非典型表现的重要性。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 对一名22岁男性患者进行单病例研究,该患者来自农村地区,表现为急性登革病毒感染,伴有腹痛、发热、呕吐和腹泻,同时出现布-奇亚里综合征和感觉性多发性神经病的体征。
elements_zh.methods: 通过实验室检查,包括登革热IgM检测、血小板减少评估和肝酶升高,确认了患者的诊断。利用超声检查、增强型计算机断层扫描和彩色多普勒成像评估肝静脉流出道阻塞。进行了血栓形成倾向筛查以评估凝血因子。
elements_zh.main_results: 患者登革热IgM检测呈阳性,伴有血小板减少(104,000/mm3)和肝酶升高。影像学检查确认了肝静脉血栓形成、下腔静脉狭窄和尾状叶增大,确立了诊断与布-奇亚里综合征的关联。血栓形成倾向筛查显示蛋白C、蛋白S和抗凝血酶III缺乏。患者还出现了严重的双下肢疼痛,神经传导研究证实了双下肢的感觉性多发性神经病。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将此病例解释为首次记录的布-奇亚里综合征与登革热相关联的病例,强调了短暂性血栓形成倾向以及布-奇亚里综合征与双侧感觉性多发性神经病的不寻常组合。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 该病例为登革病毒感染的非典型临床表现提供了重要见解,特别是与布-奇亚里综合征和感觉性多发性神经病的关联,这可能有助于更广泛的监测和登革热相关并发症的诊断方法。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于单个 病例报告,可能无法推广。然而,证据是强有力的,因为它包括详细的临床、实验室和影像学结果,支持 BCS 的 诊断 和 登革热,并具有明确的时间关系。

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 布加综合征 (BCS) 是一种罕见的肝血管疾病,其特征是肝静脉流出道阻塞,每年每百万人口中有 1-2 例出现 发病率。虽然 登革热 主要与出血并发症相关,但血栓事件却很少报道。据我们所知,这是第一个有记录的与 登革热 相关的 BCS 病例。一名22岁农村男性因腹痛、发热、呕吐、稀便病史4天就诊。体检发现肝肿大、腹水和轻度脱水。实验室检查证实登革热 IgM 阳性,伴有血小板减少 (104,000/mm 3 ) 和肝酶升高。血栓形成倾向筛查显示蛋白 C、蛋白 S 和抗凝血酶 III 缺乏。影像学研究,包括超声检查、对比计算机断层扫描和彩色多普勒,显示肝静脉血栓形成、下腔静脉狭窄和尾状叶肥大,建立了 BCS 的 诊断。上消化道内镜检查显示II级食管静脉曲张,符合门静脉高压症。入院期间,患者还出现双下肢严重疼痛,强效镇痛药无效,神经传导检查证实双下肢存在感觉性多发性神经病。该患者接受了支持性护理和使用低分子肝素 (LMWH) 的仔细抗凝治疗,随后每天服用 4 mg 华法林。尽管最初出现血小板减少,但通过密切监测出血并发症,成功开始抗凝治疗。该患者表现出良好的临床反应,随访时肝静脉血栓完全消退,肝功能正常化,腹水消退。在 6 个月的随访中,停止华法林并桥接 LMWH 后进行的重复血栓形成倾向检测显示蛋白 C、蛋白 S 和抗凝血酶 III 水平正常,表明不存在真正的遗传缺陷。该病例强调了 登革热、BCS 与患有明显但短暂的血栓形成倾向的患者的感觉多发性神经病之间的新关联。尽管同时存在血小板减少症,但早期识别、适当的抗凝和仔细的神经学评估仍可带来良好的结果。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在记录一种罕见且新颖的关联,即登革热与布-奇亚里综合征(BCS)及双侧感觉性多发性神经病之间的联系,强调识别登革病毒感染非典型表现的重要性。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 对一名22岁男性患者进行单病例研究,该患者来自农村地区,表现为急性登革病毒感染,伴有腹痛、发热、呕吐和腹泻,同时出现布-奇亚里综合征和感觉性多发性神经病的体征。
analysis_zh.methods: 通过实验室检查,包括登革热IgM检测、血小板减少评估和肝酶升高,确认了患者的诊断。利用超声检查、增强型计算机断层扫描和彩色多普勒成像评估肝静脉流出道阻塞。进行了血栓形成倾向筛查以评估凝血因子。
analysis_zh.main_results: 患者登革热IgM检测呈阳性,伴有血小板减少(104,000/mm3)和肝酶升高。影像学检查确认了肝静脉血栓形成、下腔静脉狭窄和尾状叶增大,确立了诊断与布-奇亚里综合征的关联。血栓形成倾向筛查显示蛋白C、蛋白S和抗凝血酶III缺乏。患者还出现了严重的双下肢疼痛,神经传导研究证实了双下肢的感觉性多发性神经病。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将此病例解释为首次记录的布-奇亚里综合征与登革热相关联的病例,强调了短暂性血栓形成倾向以及布-奇亚里综合征与双侧感觉性多发性神经病的不寻常组合。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 该病例为登革病毒感染的非典型临床表现提供了重要见解,特别是与布-奇亚里综合征和感觉性多发性神经病的关联,这可能有助于更广泛的监测和登革热相关并发症的诊断方法。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于单个 病例报告,可能无法推广。然而,证据是强有力的,因为它包括详细的临床、实验室和影像学结果,支持 BCS 的 诊断 和 登革热,并具有明确的时间关系。

papers.title: Clinical Characteristics, Associated Factors, Treatment Practices, and Outcomes of Dengue Fever among Adult Acute Febrile Illness Cases in Las’anod, Sool Region, Somalia: A Hospital-Based Cross-Sectional Study
papers.abstract: Background: Dengue fever is an emerging public health concern in Somalia, but evidence on its clinical presentation, serological test patterns, associated factors, treatment practices, and outcomes among adult acute febrile illness cases remains limited. This study assessed dengue fever among adult acute febrile illness cases in Las’anod, Sool Region, Somalia. Methods A hospital-based cross-sectional study was conducted among 260 adult patients with acute febrile illness assessed for dengue fever at Las’anod General Hospital, Manhal Hospital, and Somali Higher Hospital. Data were collected using a standardized data extraction checklist from patient records, clinical evaluation forms, and laboratory records. Dengue positivity was determined using serology test results. Descriptive statistics, Chi-square tests, binary logistic regression, and multivariable logistic regression were used for analysis. Adjusted odds ratios with 95% confidence intervals were reported, and statistical significance was set at p < 0.05. Results Of the 260 participants, 78 (30.0%) tested positive for dengue serology and 182 (70.0%) tested negative. Among positive cases, 61 (23.5%) were IgM positive only, and 17 (6.5%) were positive for both IgM and NS1. Fever was the most common symptom, reported by 157 (60.38%) participants. Most participants were not admitted to hospital, 229 (88.08%), and 248 (95.38%) survived, while 12 (4.62%) deaths were recorded. In multivariable analysis, age 25–35 years, monthly household income, previous dengue diagnosis, knowledge level, and indoor water storage were significantly associated with dengue positivity. Conclusions Dengue fever was a substantial contributor to acute febrile illness among adults in Las’anod. Strengthening dengue diagnosis, community awareness, safe water storage practices, vector control, and standardized clinical management may improve detection, prevention, and outcomes in resource-limited settings.

papers.title: A gut commensal Serratia marcescens inhibits dengue virus infection via prodigiosin-induced autophagy in Aedes albopictus .
papers.abstract: The mosquito gut microbiota plays a pivotal role in regulating arbovirus transmission, yet the specific antiviral metabolites produced by native symbiotic bacteria and their underlying mechanisms remain poorly understood. In this study, we isolated a natural gut symbiotic bacterium, Serratia marcescens strain WZ1, from field-caught Aedes albopictus in Wenzhou, China, and demonstrated its potent ability to inhibit dengue virus (DENV) infection. Through integrated metabolomic analysis, we identified the red pigment prodigiosin (PG) as a functional antiviral metabolite secreted by this strain. PG treatment suppressed DENV infection in mosquito cells in a dose- and time-dependent manner and significantly reduced DENV2 RNA levels in adult Ae. Mechanistic investigations revealed that PG preferentially localizes to the endoplasmic reticulum (ER), where it induces ER stress and upregulates the chaperone protein GRP78. This process subsequently activates a complete autophagic flux, as evidenced by enhanced conversion of Atg8-I to Atg8-II, increased autophagosome formation, and elevated lysosomal activity. Crucially, we further demonstrated that PG facilitates the convergence of autophagosomes and lysosomes, culminating in the colocalization of DENV with lysosomal compartments and subsequent viral clearance. Both genetic knockdown of the autophagy gene Atg8 and pharmacological inhibition of ER stress substantially attenuated PG-mediated viral suppression, confirming the functional link between PG-induced ER stress, autophagy activation, and viral clearance. Our findings elucidate a novel mechanism by which a native mosquito gut symbiont metabolite restricts arboviral infection through activation of the host ER stress-autophagy pathway, providing a mechanistic basis and candidate leads for future transmission-blocking studies.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to investigate the role of mosquito gut microbiota in regulating arbovirus transmission, with a focus on identifying specific antiviral metabolites and their mechanisms of action against dengue virus.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study involved isolating Serratia marcescens strain WZ1 from field-caught Aedes albopictus in Wenzhou, China, and demonstrating its ability to inhibit dengue virus infection. The research was conducted using mosquito cells and adult Ae.
analysis.methods: The researchers performed integrated metabolomic analysis to identify the antiviral metabolite prodigiosin (PG) secreted by Serratia marcescens strain WZ1. They evaluated PG's effects on dengue virus infection through dose- and time-dependent assays, and mechanistic investigations were conducted to determine its impact on ER stress, autophagy activation, and viral clearance.
analysis.main_results: PG treatment suppressed dengue virus infection in mosquito cells in a dose- and time-dependent manner and significantly reduced DENV2 RNA levels in adult Ae. Mechanistic investigations revealed that PG induces ER stress and upregulates GRP78, leading to autophagic flux. PG also facilitates autophagosome-lysosome convergence, resulting in viral clearance.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings reveal a novel mechanism by which a native mosquito gut symbiont metabolite restricts arboviral infection through activation of the host ER stress-autophagy pathway, offering a mechanistic basis for future transmission-blocking strategies.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results provide insights into the potential of gut microbiota-derived metabolites for developing new strategies to block dengue virus transmission, which could inform future research on surveillance, diagnosis, and intervention.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's evidence is strong, as it includes mechanistic investigations and dose-dependent results, but it is limited to in vitro and in vivo experiments with mosquito cells and adult Ae. albopictus, which may not fully represent natural transmission dynamics.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the role of the mosquito gut microbiota in dengue virus transmission, focusing on the antiviral metabolite prodigiosin (PG) produced by Serratia marcescens strain WZ1. The research demonstrates that PG inhibits dengue virus infection by inducing ER stress and activating autophagy in mosquito cells. Mechanistic studies show that PG promotes autophagosome-lysosome convergence, leading to viral clearance. These findings reveal a novel pathway by which gut bacteria can restrict dengue virus infection, offering potential for future transmission-blocking strategies. The study's results are supported by dose-dependent experiments and molecular analyses, but its scope is limited to mosquito models, which may not fully capture the complexity of natural transmission.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在探讨蚊虫肠道微生物群在调节虫媒病毒传播中的作用,重点在于鉴定特定的抗病毒药物代谢产物及其对抗登革病毒的机制。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究从中国温州地区捕获的Aedes albopictus中分离出Serratia marcescens WZ1菌株,并展示了其抑制登革病毒感染的能力。研究使用了蚊虫细胞和成年Ae. albopictus进行。
elements_zh.methods: 研究人员通过整合代谢组学分析鉴定了Serratia marcescens WZ1菌株分泌的抗病毒药物代谢产物产色菌素(PG)。他们通过剂量和时间依赖性实验评估了PG对登革病毒感染的影响,并进行了机制研究以确定其对ER应激、自噬激活和病毒清除的作用。
elements_zh.main_results: PG在剂量和时间依赖性实验中显著抑制了蚊虫细胞中的登革病毒感染,并显著降低了成年Ae. albopictus中的DENV2 RNA水平。机制研究显示,PG诱导ER应激并上调GRP78,从而引发自噬通量。PG还促进了自噬体与溶酶体的融合,导致病毒被清除。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现揭示了一种原生蚊虫肠道共生菌代谢产物通过激活宿主 ER应激-自噬通路抑制虫媒病毒感染的新机制,为未来传播阻断策略提供了机制基础。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果为利用肠道微生物群衍生代谢产物开发新的阻断虫媒病毒登革病毒和传播的策略提供了见解,可能有助于未来关于监测、诊断以及干预措施的研究。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的证据较强,因为它包括机制研究和剂量依赖性结果,但其研究局限于蚊虫细胞和成年Ae. albopictus的体外和体内实验,可能无法完全反映自然传播动态。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在探讨蚊虫肠道微生物群在调节虫媒病毒传播中的作用,重点在于鉴定特定的抗病毒药物代谢产物及其对抗登革病毒的机制。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究从中国温州地区捕获的Aedes albopictus中分离出Serratia marcescens WZ1菌株,并展示了其抑制登革病毒感染的能力。研究使用了蚊虫细胞和成年Ae. albopictus进行。
analysis_zh.methods: 研究人员通过整合代谢组学分析鉴定了Serratia marcescens WZ1菌株分泌的抗病毒药物代谢产物产色菌素(PG)。他们通过剂量和时间依赖性实验评估了PG对登革病毒感染的影响,并进行了机制研究以确定其对ER应激、自噬激活和病毒清除的作用。
analysis_zh.main_results: PG在剂量和时间依赖性实验中显著抑制了蚊虫细胞中的登革病毒感染,并显著降低了成年Ae. albopictus中的DENV2 RNA水平。机制研究显示,PG诱导ER应激并上调GRP78,从而引发自噬通量。PG还促进了自噬体与溶酶体的融合,导致病毒被清除。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现揭示了一种原生蚊虫肠道共生菌代谢产物通过激活宿主 ER应激-自噬通路抑制虫媒病毒感染的新机制,为未来传播阻断策略提供了机制基础。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果为利用肠道微生物群衍生代谢产物开发新的阻断虫媒病毒登革病毒和传播的策略提供了见解,可能有助于未来关于监测、诊断以及干预措施的研究。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的证据较强,因为它包括机制研究和剂量依赖性结果,但其研究局限于蚊虫细胞和成年Ae. albopictus的体外和体内实验,可能无法完全反映自然传播动态。

papers.title: Repurposing of DrugBank small molecules against Dengue virus capsid protein: an in silico study.
papers.abstract: UNLABELLED: Dengue virus (DENV) remains a pressing global health threat with no approved antiviral therapy to date. In this study, we explore the conserved hydrophobic pocket at the dimer interface of the dengue capsid protein as a novel target for antiviral intervention. Using a high-resolution capsid structure with modeled N-terminal disordered regions, we performed virtual screening of the entire DrugBank database employing AutoDock Vina to identify potential repurposable inhibitors. Six top-binding candidates were shortlisted based on docking scores and binding site specificity. These molecules were subjected to classical molecular dynamics (MD) simulations to evaluate complex stability, followed by thermal titration MD (TTMD) to assess interaction robustness under thermal stress. Three molecules-DB02152, DB08683, and DB13014-exhibited highly stable binding throughout both MD and TTMD analyses, with DB13014 (Hypericin) showing the highest thermal stability and favorable interaction energy. In silico ADMET profiling further validated the drug-like properties of these compounds, indicating acceptable oral bioavailability, low toxicity risk, and synthetic tractability. These findings highlight the dengue capsid hydrophobic pocket as a viable drug target and propose repurposing of small molecules as anti-dengue therapeutics. SUPPLEMENTARY INFORMATION: The online version contains supplementary material available at https://doi.org/10.1007/s40203-026-00738-w.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 登革病毒(登革病毒)仍然是一个紧迫的全球健康威胁,目前尚无批准的抗病毒药物治疗方法。本研究旨在识别针对登革病毒衣壳蛋白的潜在可再利用抑制剂。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究是一项计算机模拟调查,探讨登革病毒衣壳蛋白二聚体界面处的保守疏水口袋。该研究使用包含建模的N端无序区域的高分辨率衣壳结构对DrugBank数据库进行虚拟筛选。
elements_zh.methods: 使用包含建模的N端无序区域的高分辨率衣壳结构,我们通过AutoDock Vina对DrugBank数据库进行了虚拟筛选,以识别潜在的可再利用抑制剂。根据对接评分和结合位点特异性,筛选出六个最佳结合候选分子。这些分子随后接受了经典分子动力学(MD)模拟以评估复合物的稳定性,并通过热滴定分子动力学(TTMD)评估其在热应激下的相互作用稳定性。
elements_zh.main_results: 三种分子(DB02152、DB08683和DB13014)在MD和TTMD分析中表现出高度稳定的结合,其中DB13014(Hypericin)显示出最高的热稳定性和有利的相互作用能量。计算机模拟的ADMET分析进一步验证了这些化合物的药物特性,表明其口服生物利用度可接受、毒性风险低且易于合成。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现突显了登革病毒衣壳蛋白疏水口袋作为可行的药物靶点,并提出了小分子药物再利用作为抗登革热治疗的可能性。本研究引入了一种新颖的方法,通过关注衣壳蛋白的结构特征来识别潜在的抑制剂。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果为这些化合物作为抗登革热治疗的进一步实验验证提供了基础,为药物开发提供了潜在的先导化合物。这可能为未来关于现有药物再利用用于登革热治疗的研究提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究仅限于计算机模拟方法,可能无法完全反映体内条件。由于研究结果基于计算模型,证据强度中等,需要实验验证。

papers.title: Insights into Dengue Prevalence, Outbreaks, Virus Replication, Diagnosis, Treatment, Vector Control, and Preventive Strategies: A Comprehensive Review
papers.abstract: Dengue virus (DENV), a mosquito-borne RNA virus of the Flaviviridae family, poses a major global health challenge, with nearly half of the world’s population at risk and annual cases ranging from 100 to 400 million. It is transmitted primarily by Aedes mosquitoes, specifically Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus, which thrive in tropical and subtropical regions. The virus consists of four serotypes (DENV-1 to DENV-4), each conferring lifelong immunity against reinfection by the same serotype but lacking cross-immunity. The increasing incidence of dengue outbreaks is driven by climate change, urbanization, and inadequate vector control measures, with regions such as South Asia, the Americas, and Southeast Asia reporting millions of cases annually. This review provides a comprehensive analysis of dengue epidemiology, virus transmission dynamics, replication mechanisms, clinical manifestations, and diagnostic approaches. It also explores recent advancements in vaccine development, particularly the comparison between Qdenga and Dengvaxia, highlighting their differences in efficacy, safety, and target populations. Despite efforts in vaccine research, vector control remains the primary strategy for dengue prevention, focusing on environmental management, biological control, and targeted chemical interventions. The study further examines Bangladesh as a case study, documenting its largest-ever dengue outbreak in 2023 and its transition into an endemic phase in early 2025. The findings underscore the urgent need for enhanced surveillance systems, integrated vector management, and public health initiatives to combat dengue globally. Strengthening diagnostic capabilities, expanding vaccination programs, and investing in innovative mosquito control strategies will be crucial in mitigating the growing burden of dengue worldwide. Bangladesh Journal of Infectious Diseases, June 2026;13(1):397-410

papers.source_body_en: Dengue virus (DENV), a mosquito-borne RNA virus of the Flaviviridae family, poses a major global health challenge, with nearly half of the world’s population at risk and annual cases ranging from 100 to 400 million. It is transmitted primarily by Aedes mosquitoes, specifically Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus, which thrive in tropical and subtropical regions. The virus consists of four serotypes (DENV-1 to DENV-4), each conferring lifelong immunity against reinfection by the same serotype but lacking cross-immunity. The increasing incidence of dengue outbreaks is driven by climate change, urbanization, and inadequate vector control measures, with regions such as South Asia, the Americas, and Southeast Asia reporting millions of cases annually. This review provides a comprehensive analysis of dengue epidemiology, virus transmission dynamics, replication mechanisms, clinical manifestations, and diagnostic approaches. It also explores recent advancements in vaccine development, particularly the comparison between Qdenga and Dengvaxia, highlighting their differences in efficacy, safety, and target populations. Despite efforts in vaccine research, vector control remains the primary strategy for dengue prevention, focusing on environmental management, biological control, and targeted chemical interventions. The study further examines Bangladesh as a case study, documenting its largest-ever dengue outbreak in 2023 and its transition into an endemic phase in early 2025. The findings underscore the urgent need for enhanced surveillance systems, integrated vector management, and public health initiatives to combat dengue globally. Strengthening diagnostic capabilities, expanding vaccination programs, and investing in innovative mosquito control strategies will be crucial in mitigating the growing burden of dengue worldwide. papers.title: Acute Dengue-associated Myocarditis in a Resource-limited Setting: A Case Series From Côte D'ivoire
papers.abstract: Abstract Dengue fever can progress to severe organ dysfunction, known as the expanded dengue syndrome. Among its atypical complications, acute myocarditis is rare, underdiagnosed, and potentially fatal. We report a series of four young male patients admitted to Treichville University Hospital (Abidjan, Côte d’Ivoire) illustrating the diverse spectrum of dengue-related myocarditis. Presentations ranged from acute heart failure to high-grade atrioventricular block requiring temporary transvenous pacing, occurring during different phases of dengue illness While elevated high-sensitivity troponin was a consistent warning sign, 3-Tesla cardiac magnetic resonance (CMR) imaging definitively confirmed myocardial inflammation via localized edema and subepicardial late gadolinium enhancement. This series highlights the need for a high index of suspicion during dengue outbreaks, where management demands a careful balance between fluid resuscitation and myocardial strain.

elements_zh.main_results: 患者表现出一系列症状,从急性心力衰竭到需要临时经静脉起搏的高危房室传导阻滞。高敏肌钙蛋白水平在所有病例中均一致升高,3特斯拉CMR成像在所有病例中均明确确认了心肌炎症。

papers.title: Bioluminescence-based high-throughput screening and identification of direct-acting dengue virus NS5 methyltransferase inhibitors.
papers.abstract: Dengue virus (DENV) is a mosquito-borne orthoflavivirus that infects millions of people annually across tropical and subtropical regions, posing a severe and growing threat to global public health. Currently there are no antiviral drugs available for DENV infection. The methyltransferase domain of non-structural protein 5 (NS5 MTase) catalyzes two essential methylation reaction in synthesis of the 5' cap-1 structure of viral mRNA, making it a promising yet under-validated target for anti-DENV drug development. Herein, we optimized a bioluminescence-based enzymatic MTase-Glo assay using purified recombinant DENV NS5 MTase and performed high-throughput screening of the focused Methylation Compound Library. Four compounds-SGC0946, AMI-1, salirasib, and gambogenic acid-were identified as potent DENV methylation inhibitors effective against all four serotypes (DENV-1 to -4). Surface plasmon resonance (SPR) analysis confirmed the direct binding between inhibitors and NS5 MTase. Among them, SGC0946 exhibited the strongest inhibitory activity with a half-maximal inhibitory concentration (IC 50 ) of 0.05-0.11 μM against DENV-1 to -4. Molecular docking predicted that SGC0946 binds to the S-adenosylmethionine (SAM)-binding pocket of NS5 MTase. In addition, SGC0946 suppressed DENV replication in C6/36 and BHK-21 cells with EC50 values of 6.67 and 0.60 μM, respectively. Collectively, these findings identify novel DENV MTase inhibitors with diverse scaffolds and provide valuable molecular insights for the rational design of more potent NS5 MTase-targeting inhibitors in the future.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Dengue virus (DENV) is a mosquito-borne orthoflavivirus that infects millions of people annually across tropical and subtropical regions, posing a severe and growing threat to global public health. The study aimed to identify direct-acting inhibitors of DENV NS5 methyltransferase as a potential target for antiviral drug development.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study was conducted using a bioluminescence-based enzymatic MTase-Glo assay with purified recombinant DENV NS5 MTase and a high-throughput screening approach of the focused Methylation Compound Library. The research focused on DENV-1 to DENV-4, with no mention of other flaviviruses or host populations.
analysis.methods: The methyltransferase domain of non-structural protein 5 (NS5 MTase) was used to catalyze methylation reactions in the synthesis of the 5' cap-1 structure of viral mRNA. The study optimized a bioluminescence-based enzymatic MTase-Glo assay using purified recombinant DENV NS5 MTase and performed high-throughput screening of the focused Methylation Compound Library.
analysis.main_results: Four compounds-SGC0946, AMI-1, salirasib, and gambogenic acid-were identified as potent DENV methylation inhibitors effective against all four serotypes (DENV-1 to -4). Among them, SGC0946 exhibited the strongest inhibitory activity with a half-maximal inhibitory concentration (IC 50 ) of 0.05-0.11 μM against DENV-1 to -4.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The study identified novel DENV MTase inhibitors with diverse scaffolds and provided valuable molecular insights for the rational design of more potent NS5 MTase-targeting inhibitors in the future.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings offer potential molecular targets for the development of antiviral drugs against DENV infection, which could significantly impact public health by providing new therapeutic options for dengue disease.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study does not report limitations, but the evidence is based on in vitro assays and molecular docking predictions, which may not fully reflect in vivo efficacy or clinical relevance. The confidence in these findings is moderate.

analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to identify direct-acting inhibitors of the dengue virus NS5 methyltransferase, a promising target for antiviral drug development. Using a bioluminescence-based enzymatic MTase-Glo assay and high-throughput screening, four compounds were found to inhibit DENV methylation across all four serotypes. SGC0946 showed the strongest inhibitory activity with an IC50 of 0.05-0.11 μM. Molecular docking suggested SGC0946 binds to the SAM-binding pocket of NS5 MTase. These findings provide molecular insights for the design of more potent anti-DENV drugs. However, the study relies on in vitro data, which may not fully translate to clinical applications, limiting the confidence in the results to a moderate level.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 登革病毒(DENV)是一种通过蚊子传播的正黄病毒科病毒,每年在热带和亚热带地区感染数百万人,对全球公共卫生构成严重且日益增长的威胁。本研究旨在鉴定DENV NS5甲基转移酶的直接作用抑制剂,作为抗病毒药物药物开发的潜在靶点。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究采用基于生物发光的酶促 MTase-Glo 测定法和纯化的重组 DENV NS5 MTase 以及聚焦甲基化化合物库的高通量筛选方法进行。该研究重点关注 DENV-1 至 DENV-4,没有提及其他黄病毒或 宿主 群体。
elements_zh.methods: 非结构蛋白 5 (NS5 MTase) 的甲基转移酶结构域用于催化病毒 mRNA 5' cap-1 结构合成中的甲基化反应。该研究使用纯化的重组 DENV NS5 MTase 优化了基于生物发光的酶促 MTase-Glo 测定,并对重点甲基化化合物库进行了高通量筛选。
elements_zh.main_results: 四种化合物——SGC0946、AMI-1、salirasib 和 gambogenic Acid——被确定为有效对抗所有四种血清型(DENV-1 至 -4)的有效 DENV 甲基化抑制剂。其中,SGC0946对DENV-1至-4表现出最强的抑制活性,半数抑制浓度(IC 50 )为0.05-0.11μM。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究确定了具有不同支架的新型 DENV MTase 抑制剂,并为未来合理设计更有效的 NS5 MTase 靶向抑制剂提供了宝贵的分子见解。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现为开发抗登革热病毒感染的 抗病毒药物 药物提供了潜在的分子靶标,这可能通过为登革热疾病提供新的治疗选择来显着影响公共健康。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究没有报告局限性,但证据是基于体外测定和分子对接预测,这可能无法完全反映体内疗效或临床相关性。这些发现的可信度是中等的。

papers.title_zh: 基于生物发光的直接作用 登革病毒 NS5 甲基转移酶抑制剂的高通量筛选和鉴定。
papers.source_body_en: Dengue virus (DENV) is a mosquito-borne orthoflavivirus that infects millions of people annually across tropical and subtropical regions, posing a severe and growing threat to global public health. Currently there are no antiviral drugs available for DENV infection. The methyltransferase domain of non-structural protein 5 (NS5 MTase) catalyzes two essential methylation reaction in synthesis of the 5' cap-1 structure of viral mRNA, making it a promising yet under-validated target for anti-DENV drug development. Herein, we optimized a bioluminescence-based enzymatic MTase-Glo assay using purified recombinant DENV NS5 MTase and performed high-throughput screening of the focused Methylation Compound Library. Four compounds-SGC0946, AMI-1, salirasib, and gambogenic acid-were identified as potent DENV methylation inhibitors effective against all four serotypes (DENV-1 to -4). Surface plasmon resonance (SPR) analysis confirmed the direct binding between inhibitors and NS5 MTase. Among them, SGC0946 exhibited the strongest inhibitory activity with a half-maximal inhibitory concentration (IC 50 ) of 0.05-0.11 μM against DENV-1 to -4. Molecular docking predicted that SGC0946 binds to the S-adenosylmethionine (SAM)-binding pocket of NS5 MTase. In addition, SGC0946 suppressed DENV replication in C6/36 and BHK-21 cells with EC50 values of 6.67 and 0.60 μM, respectively. Collectively, these findings identify novel DENV MTase inhibitors with diverse scaffolds and provide valuable molecular insights for the rational design of more potent NS5 MTase-targeting inhibitors in the future.

papers.title: Experimental and In Silico Analysis of the Structural Dynamics of Dengue NS2B-NS3 Protease
papers.abstract: Abstract The Dengue virus (DENV), a major global health concern, causes dengue fever, predominantly affecting tropical and subtropical regions. The NS2B-NS3 protease complex of DENV is critical for viral replication, making it a promising target for antiviral drug development. This study investigates the structural dynamics of the NS2B-NS3 protease under varying pH conditions, integrating experimental and computational approaches. The recombinant NS2B-NS3 protease was expressed in E. coli, purified using affinity chromatography, and analysed for purity via SDS-PAGE. Circular dichroism (CD) spectroscopy revealed pH-dependent secondary structural changes, indicating stability at neutral to slightly basic pH and destabilization under acidic and highly basic conditions. Dynamic light scattering (DLS) analysis demonstrated protein aggregation and structural heterogeneity under extreme pH levels. Complementary in silico techniques, including homology modelling and molecular dynamics (MD) simulations, provided detailed insights into the conformational changes of the protease. The modelled structure, validated and refined through computational tools, revealed structural stability at physiological pH, with notable disruptions at pH extremes. DSSP (Dictionary of Secondary Structure of Proteins) and principal component analyses highlighted significant secondary structural transitions, especially at acidic pH where α-helices and β-sheets transformed into random coils Docking and MD simulation was carried out with the small molecule for therapeutic analysis between Dengue NS2bNS3 and small molecule. This study emphasizes the pH-dependent conformational plasticity of the NS2B-NS3 protease, contributing to the understanding of its functional mechanisms and providing a foundation for the rational design of pH-specific inhibitors. These findings underscore the importance of structural biology in advancing therapeutic strategies against dengue fever.

The modelled structure, validated and refined through computational tools, revealed structural stability at physiological pH, with notable disruptions at pH extremes. The modelled structure, validated and refined through computational tools, revealed structural stability at physiological pH, with notable disruptions at pH extremes. DSSP (Dictionary of Secondary Structure of Proteins) and principal component analyses highlighted significant secondary structural transitions, especially at acidic pH where α-helices and β-sheets transformed into random coils Docking and MD simulation was carried out with the small molecule for therapeutic analysis between Dengue NS2bNS3 and small molecule. This study emphasizes the pH-dependent conformational plasticity of the NS2B-NS3 protease, contributing to the understanding of its functional mechanisms and providing a foundation for the rational design of pH-specific inhibitors. papers.full_text: To the Editor: Preventable pediatric dengue deaths persist despite advances, underscoring the importance of mortality audits to improve care [1, 2]. We retrospectively audited all laboratory-confirmed pediatric dengue deaths (1 mo–15 y) admitted to our tertiary care centre between March and December 2024 to identify potentially modifiable contributors to mortality. Seventeen deaths were analyzed. Most children presented during the critical phase of illness with hypotension (82.4%), plasma leakage (approximately 80%), oliguria (76.5%), and multiorgan dysfunction (64.7%), indicating advanced disease at presentation. Severe dengue shock at admission (70.6%) and multiorgan dysfunction (58.8%) were the predominant non-modifiable factors associated with mortality (Supplementary Table S1). However, modifiable factors were identified in 14 (82.4%) children. Delayed recognition of compensated shock occurred in 12 patients and was predominantly attributable to delayed identification by healthcare providers at referring facilities or during the early hospital course rather than delayed caregiver presentation. Consequently, many children reached our centre with established decompensated shock. Fluid management issues were identified in 10 patients and included delayed initiation of resuscitation, inadequate titration of intravenous fluids during compensated shock, and continuation of aggressive fluid therapy beyond the plasma leakage phase, resulting in fluid overload and respiratory compromise. Delayed recognition of acute kidney injury was documented in nine patients because declining urine output and worsening renal function were not detected early, delaying escalation of supportive management. These observations are consistent with previous dengue mortality audits demonstrating that deficiencies in early recognition, monitoring, and protocol-based management substantially contribute to preventable deaths [2,3,4]. Our audit suggests that although intrinsic disease severity remains an important determinant of mortality, many pediatric dengue deaths are potentially preventable. Regular training on early recognition of compensated shock, strict adherence to WHO fluid management guidelines, systematic monitoring of urine output and renal function, and timely referral from peripheral healthcare facilities may substantially reduce dengue-related mortality in children [1,2,3,4]. papers.title: Proactive Initiative to Establish a Dengue-Free Factory Assessment Framework in Dengue High-Risk Industrial Areas: A Narrative Review.
papers.abstract: Dengue poses a growing threat in endemic countries where industrial expansion intersects with Aedes vector-breeding habitats. Factories and manufacturing premises often generate a multitude of unmanaged water-holding containers-including water storage tanks, machinery components, landscaping features, and recyclable waste-that favor perennial reservoirs for Aedes aegypti vectors. Despite substantial public health burdens, occupational dengue prevention in the workplace remains largely reactive, fragmented, and insufficiently aligned with safety, health, and environment (SHE) management systems. This narrative review synthesizes evidence on dengue epidemiology in industrial contexts, larval source ecology in factory environments, workers' dengue risk perception, and the regulatory landscape governing occupational health in dengue-endemic countries. Drawing on these evidence domains, we propose the conceptual foundations of a proactive "Dengue-Free Factory Assessment Framework" (D-FAF) designed to prevent and reduce Ae. aegypti breeding and high dengue risk in workplaces in industrial areas, safeguard employee health, minimize work loss, and achieve a sustained reduction in dengue incidence. The framework integrates the "Plan-Do-Check-Act" (PDCA) logic of ISO 45001 and ISO 14001 into a scalable, standards-aligned tool applicable across diverse industrial sectors in dengue high-risk areas.

papers.title: Modelling the impact of the El Nino Southern Oscillation (ENSO) on the dynamics of Dengue outbreaks in Argentina between 2018 and 2024.
papers.abstract: BackgroundDengue fever has become an epidemiological concern worldwide, with 531,617 cases reported in Argentina during the 2023-2024 season. The El Nino- Southern Oscillation (ENSO) phenomenon has been linked to changes in dengue dynamics. This study assessed the relationships among ENSO, local climatic variables, and dengue outbreaks in Argentina from 2018 to 2024. MethodsA nationwide spatiotemporal analysis was conducted using dengue cases and monthly mean temperature, relative humidity, and rainfall. The Southern Oscillation Index (SOI) was used as the ENSO indicator (El Nino phase= 0.5). We fitted Hierarchical Bayesian models with Integrated Nested Laplace Approximation (INLA). A Negative Binomial distribution of dengue cases was used to account for overdispersion. Spatial dependence was modeled by using the Besag-York-Mollie 2 (BYM2) structure, adjusted for population. ResultsThe final model explained 53.7% of the variation in Argentinas departmental monthly dengue cases during the study period. Exposure-response curves of posterior probability and 95% credible intervals suggested that dengue risk increased when monthly mean temperatures were between 20{degrees} and 30{degrees} Celsius during the El Nino or neutral phase, with less consistent effects during the La Nina phase. Humidity >50% was associated with increased dengue risk during the La Nina phase, with less steep or absent associations during El Nino or neutral phases. Negative SOI scores were associated with an increased risk of dengue after controlling for the covariates. ConclusionDengue outbreaks in Argentina were independently associated with temperatures between 20 and 30 {degrees}C during the El Nino and neutral phases, humidity > 50% during the La Nina phase, and the El Nino phase of the ENSO. Incorporating ENSO indices into predictive models could enhance early warning systems and timely public health interventions in Argentina. HIGHLIGHTSO_LIThis study linked the El Nino phenomenon to Dengue fever outbreaks in Argentina. C_LIO_LIOther predictors of increased risk were monthly mean temperatures between 20{degrees} and 30{degrees} Celsius during the El Nino and neutral phases, and humidity > 50% during the La Nina phase. C_LIO_LIThere was a high degree of spatial residual variance, not accounted for by the factors considered in the model, in dengue risk, which was increased in some northern and southern provinces of Argentina.

papers.title_zh: 模拟 2018 年至 2024 年间厄尔尼诺南方涛动 (ENSO) 对阿根廷登革热 暴发 动态的影响。
papers.source_body_en: BackgroundDengue fever has become an epidemiological concern worldwide, with 531,617 cases reported in Argentina during the 2023-2024 season. The El Nino- Southern Oscillation (ENSO) phenomenon has been linked to changes in dengue dynamics. This study assessed the relationships among ENSO, local climatic variables, and dengue outbreaks in Argentina from 2018 to 2024. MethodsA nationwide spatiotemporal analysis was conducted using dengue cases and monthly mean temperature, relative humidity, and rainfall. The Southern Oscillation Index (SOI) was used as the ENSO indicator (El Nino phase= 0.5). We fitted Hierarchical Bayesian models with Integrated Nested Laplace Approximation (INLA). A Negative Binomial distribution of dengue cases was used to account for overdispersion. Spatial dependence was modeled by using the Besag-York-Mollie 2 (BYM2) structure, adjusted for population. ResultsThe final model explained 53.7% of the variation in Argentinas departmental monthly dengue cases during the study period. Exposure-response curves of posterior probability and 95% credible intervals suggested that dengue risk increased when monthly mean temperatures were between 20{degrees} and 30{degrees} Celsius during the El Nino or neutral phase, with less consistent effects during the La Nina phase. Humidity >50% was associated with increased dengue risk during the La Nina phase, with less steep or absent associations during El Nino or neutral phases. Negative SOI scores were associated with an increased risk of dengue after controlling for the covariates. ConclusionDengue outbreaks in Argentina were independently associated with temperatures between 20 and 30 {degrees}C during the El Nino and neutral phases, humidity > 50% during the La Nina phase, and the El Nino phase of the ENSO. Incorporating ENSO indices into predictive models could enhance early warning systems and timely public health interventions in Argentina. HIGHLIGHTSO_LIThis study linked the El Nino phenomenon to Dengue fever outbreaks in Argentina. C_LIO_LIOther predictors of increased risk were monthly mean temperatures between 20{degrees} and 30{degrees} Celsius during the El Nino and neutral phases, and humidity > 50% during the La Nina phase. C_LIO_LIThere was a high degree of spatial residual variance, not accounted for by the factors considered in the model, in dengue risk, which was increased in some northern and southern provinces of Argentina.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景登革热已成为全球流行病学关注的问题,2023-2024 年季节阿根廷报告了 531,617 例病例。厄尔尼诺南方涛动 (ENSO) 现象与登革热动态变化有关。本研究评估了2018年至2024年阿根廷ENSO、当地气候变量和登革热暴发之间的关系。方法利用登革热病例和月平均气温、相对湿度和降雨量进行全国时空分析。南方涛动指数(SOI)被用作ENSO指标(厄尔尼诺相位= 0.5)。我们使用集成嵌套拉普拉斯逼近(INLA)来拟合分层贝叶斯模型。使用登革热病例的负二项分布来解释过度分散的情况。使用 Besag-York-Mollie 2 (BYM2) 结构对空间依赖性进行建模,并根据人口进行调整。结果最终模型解释了研究期间阿根廷部门每月登革热病例的 53.7% 的变异。后验概率和 95% 可信区间的暴露-反应曲线表明,在厄尔尼诺或中性阶段,当月平均气温在 20°C 至 30°C 之间时,登革热风险增加,而在拉尼娜阶段,影响不太一致。湿度 >50% 与拉尼娜阶段的登革热风险增加相关,而在厄尔尼诺阶段或中性阶段,相关性不太陡峭或不存在。控制协变量后,负 SOI 评分与登革热风险增加相关。结论 阿根廷登革热 暴发 与厄尔尼诺和中性阶段温度在 20 至 30°C 之间、拉尼娜阶段湿度 > 50% 以及 ENSO 厄尔尼诺阶段湿度独立相关。将 ENSO 指数纳入预测模型可以增强阿根廷的早期预警系统和及时的公共卫生干预措施。亮点SO_LI这项研究将厄尔尼诺现象与阿根廷的 登革热 暴发 联系起来。C_LIO_LIO风险增加的其他预测因素是厄尔尼诺和中性阶段的月平均气温在 20 摄氏度到 30 摄氏度之间,拉尼娜阶段的湿度> 50%。C_LIO_LI 登革热风险存在高度的空间残差方差,但模型中考虑的因素并未对此进行解释,而登革热风险在阿根廷北部和南部的一些省份有所增加。

papers.title: Severe Dengue in Children: Pathogenesis, Early Recognition, and Evidence-Informed Management
papers.abstract: Severe dengue remains an important cause of pediatric hospitalization, morbidity, and mortality in tropical and subtropical regions, particularly where rapid triage and pediatric critical-care capacity are limited. This structured narrative review synthesizes evidence on the epidemiology, pathogenesis, early recognition, diagnosis, management, and prevention of severe dengue in children. Severe disease reflects interactions among viral factors, pre-existing immunity, dysregulated host responses, and microvascular endothelial injury. Antibody-dependent enhancement, inflammatory mediators, dengue nonstructural protein 1, and endothelial glycocalyx disruption contribute to vascular hyperpermeability, plasma leakage, shock, severe bleeding, and organ impairment. Because deterioration often occurs abruptly around defervescence, serial clinical assessment, hematocrit trends, urine-output monitoring, and timely recognition of warning signs are central to risk stratification. Molecular assays and NS1 antigen testing are most useful during the early febrile phase, although diagnostic performance varies with illness timing and immune status. Carefully titrated isotonic crystalloid therapy remains the cornerstone of treatment; both delayed resuscitation and excessive fluid administration may worsen outcomes. Reducing mortality requires integrated clinical and public-health strategies combining standardized pediatric management, accessible diagnostics, effective referral systems, vaccination where appropriate, surveillance, and vector control.

papers.source_body_en: Severe dengue remains an important cause of pediatric hospitalization, morbidity, and mortality in tropical and subtropical regions, particularly where rapid triage and pediatric critical-care capacity are limited. This structured narrative review synthesizes evidence on the epidemiology, pathogenesis, early recognition, diagnosis, management, and prevention of severe dengue in children. Severe disease reflects interactions among viral factors, pre-existing immunity, dysregulated host responses, and microvascular endothelial injury. Antibody-dependent enhancement, inflammatory mediators, dengue nonstructural protein 1, and endothelial glycocalyx disruption contribute to vascular hyperpermeability, plasma leakage, shock, severe bleeding, and organ impairment. Because deterioration often occurs abruptly around defervescence, serial clinical assessment, hematocrit trends, urine-output monitoring, and timely recognition of warning signs are central to risk stratification. Molecular assays and NS1 antigen testing are most useful during the early febrile phase, although diagnostic performance varies with illness timing and immune status. Carefully titrated isotonic crystalloid therapy remains the cornerstone of treatment; both delayed resuscitation and excessive fluid administration may worsen outcomes. Reducing mortality requires integrated clinical and public-health strategies combining standardized pediatric management, accessible diagnostics, effective referral systems, vaccination where appropriate, surveillance, and vector control.

papers.title: Molecular detection and spatial distribution of circulating dengue virus serotypes in an urban high-incidence area of Mataram, Indonesia (2024–2025)
papers.abstract: Abstract Dengue fever (DF) is a mosquito-borne viral disease caused by four dengue virus serotypes (DENV-1 to DENV-4) and remains a major public health concern in tropical regions, including Indonesia. In 2024, Mataram City reported 364 confirmed dengue cases, indicating a substantial local burden. This observational cross-sectional study was conducted from November 2024 to January 2025 in eight high-incidence neighborhood associations within the Karang Pule Health Center working area, Mataram City. Mosquito larvae and ovitrap samples were collected from case-based households following WHO entomological surveillance guidelines, reared to F1 adult females, and pooled (20 mosquitoes per site) for viral RNA extraction. Dengue virus detection and serotyping were performed using a one-step RT-PCR assay with serotype-specific primers, including appropriate positive and negative controls to ensure assay validity. Five of eight sampling locations were positive for DENV. DENV-3 was the predominant serotype, detected in three locations, while co-circulation of DENV-2 and DENV-3 was identified in two locations. No DENV-1 or DENV-4 was detected. Villages such as West Pagutan exhibited the highest proportion of reported cases and incidence rates. Environmental parameters (temperature, humidity, water temperature, and light intensity) were recorded at each site and analyzed descriptively. The detection of DENV in F1-generation Aedes aegypti supports evidence of ongoing local viral circulation and suggests the potential contribution of vertical (transovarial) transmission in maintaining the virus reservoir. This study provides fine-scale, sub-district-level mapping of dengue serotype distribution in an urban Indonesian setting, offering localized evidence to support targeted vector control strategies while acknowledging limitations related to sample size and geographic coverage.
papers.journal: Journal of Umm Al-Qura University for Applied Sciences
