Although the case trend declined in 2025, DHF remains a health priority that requires effective prevention strategies and public education [2]. As case numbers rise, the Indonesian public increasingly relies on social media as a source of health information. YouTube has a unique characteristic as a multimodal platform: its content combines visual elements in the form of video thumbnails and textual elements in the form of user comments, which jointly shape public health perceptions and behaviour [3]. However, the openness of this platform also presents challenges, because the information that circulates is not always accurate and can negatively affect public health decisions [4]. Identifying the most influential actors in the dissemination of DHF information is crucial for designing well-targeted interventions. Social Network Analysis (SNA) has proven effective for this purpose: centrality metrics such as PageRank, degree centrality, and betweenness centrality are widely used to measure the level of influence of a node in a network [5], while community detection through the Louvain algorithm enables actors to be grouped according to similar interaction patterns [6]. However, previous research applying SNA to health information has been dominated by text-based platforms such as Twitter and Facebook [7]. As a result, when influence is measured solely from textual signals, the visual dimension that also Received: June 18, 2026. License details: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/ determines the reach of content, particularly thumbnails on platforms such as YouTube, is entirely overlooked. In computer vision, ResNet-50 is a deep learning architecture widely used for visual feature extraction because its residual learning approach enables the construction of deep networks with effective training [11]. Multimodal approaches that fuse textual and visual features have been shown to improve analytical accuracy compared with unimodal approaches [12]. In particular, the Adaptive Gated Fusion (AGF) technique combines the two modalities through a gating mechanism that assigns dynamic per-dimension weights between text and visual features [13], so that the contribution of each modality is not set uniformly but is adjusted to the characteristics of each piece of content. AGF therefore has the potential to address the limitations of text-based analysis by integrating the visual signals that have so far been ignored in identifying influential actors on multimodal platforms. Based on the review above, two main gaps can be identified. First, studies on influential actors in health information still focus on text-based platforms, whereas YouTube, which combines text and visuals, has not been widely studied. Second, SNA research generally still uses only a single type of data, so the visual information in video content has not been optimally exploited; in particular, the combination of IndoBERT and ResNet-50 through adaptive fusion to build a co-audience network has never been explored. The main objectives of this study are described as follows: 1. Multimodal Representation: integrating IndoBERT textual embeddings and ResNet-50 visual embeddings through Adaptive Gated Fusion (AGF), which assigns adaptive per- dimension weights across modalities, without relying on the audio modality. 2. Network Construction: building a co-audience graph based on multimodal content similarity derived from AGF, rather than explicit interactions, and applying PageRank-based SNA to identify influential channels together with their community structure. 3. Sentiment Profiling: fine-tuning a RoBERTa model for Indonesian text to build sentiment profiles for each influential channel. 4. Empirical Validation: conducting an ablation study with stratified 5-fold cross-validation on seven modality configurations to evaluate whether the adaptively fused multimodal representation outperforms the unimodal text and visual baselines in sentiment classification accuracy. Section 3 describes the dataset and the proposed AGF-based multimodal framework. Section 4 presents the experimental results and discussion. Finally, Section 5 concludes the paper and outlines directions for future work. 2. Related works 2.1 Multimodal sentiment analysis Multimodal sentiment analysis combines information from several modalities, typically text, audio, and visual, to produce a richer representation than a single modality alone. Gandhi et al. [14] concluded that multimodal fusion methods outperform unimodal approaches across various datasets, and Zhu et al. [15] reinforced this finding through a survey of fusion methods that emphasised that selecting the appropriate fusion strategy is highly decisive for model performance. In a domain similar to this study, Kothuri and RajaLakshmi [16] proposed the MALO-LSTM model, which combines text, audio, and visual modalities for sentiment analysis on YouTube; the model achieved 98.62% accuracy and showed that combining the three modalities yields better results than using the modalities separately. Recent research emphasises the importance of adaptive fusion mechanisms, that is, mechanisms that adjust the weight of each modality according to context. Wang et al. [17] proposed a multimodal transformer that assigns modality weights adaptively, whereas Lu et al. [18] developed a gated-fusion- based framework that has been shown to filter signals across modalities through a sigmoid gate that dynamically determines the magnitude of each Received: June 18, 2026. License details: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/ modality's contribution [19]. However, most of these methods were developed for English-language data and still rely on the audio modality, so the potential of the visual modality in the form of thumbnails, the primary signal on platforms such as YouTube, has not been optimally exploited, particularly for Indonesian-language content. 2.2 Social network analysis for influential actor identification Social Network Analysis (SNA) is widely used to identify key actors in online information networks. The PageRank algorithm, originally designed to rank web pages [20] was later adapted to the social network context, measuring the influence of a node not only from the number of connections but also from their quality. Rashidi et al. [21] developed a method to predict influential nodes based on local communities and user reaction information, and the results showed that nodes with high PageRank values tend to be effective information spreaders. Similarly, data-driven frameworks combine several centrality metrics such as degree centrality, betweenness centrality, and PageRank to make node rankings more accurate [22]. In the health context, identifying influential actors is highly important for designing public communication strategies. A qualitative study by Green et al. showed that digital opinion leaders play an important role in disseminating dengue prevention information, including in Indonesia [23]. However, most studies still build relationships between users from explicit interactions such as retweets and mentions, even though users who discuss similar topics do not necessarily interact with one another. Therefore, approaches based on multimodal embeddings that can capture content similarity remain underexplored. 2.3 Sentiment analysis of health content on social media Sentiment analysis of health content on social media can provide insight into how the public perceives a disease. In the case of dengue, Laguitan et al. [24] found that the quality and reliability of information circulating on YouTube vary widely, so not all sources have the same credibility and it is important to identify trustworthy sources. In Indonesia, Putri et al. [25] used IndoBERT to analyse public sentiment toward various public issues, whereas Mahakerty et al. [26] integrated Indonesian- language Twitter sentiment analysis into a deep- learning-based disease prediction model. These findings show that sentiment analysis can serve as a useful supplementary source of information for understanding the dynamics of disease spread in society. 2.4 Research gap Based on the literature review above, there are three research gaps centred on the suboptimal use of multimodal representations. First, research on multimodal sentiment analysis is still dominated by English-language data and rarely focuses on the Indonesian language, particularly in the health domain. Second, most multimodal methods rely on the audio modality, whereas the combination of text and visual thumbnails, which is precisely the primary signal on platforms such as YouTube, has not been widely studied. Third, the construction of co- audience networks to identify influential actors still depends on explicit interactions and has not exploited cross-modal content similarity, so the visual dimension that also determines content reach is overlooked. These gaps underscore the need for an Indonesian-language multimodal framework that explicitly combines the text and visual modalities to identify influential actors in the dissemination of dengue information on YouTube. Unlike previous research, the main novelty of this study lies in integrating IndoBERT text representations and ResNet-50 thumbnail visual features through Adaptive Gated Fusion (AGF), which assigns adaptive per-dimension weights across modalities without relying on the audio modality. The resulting multimodal fused representation is then used to build a co-audience network based on content similarity rather than explicit interactions, and the contribution of each modality is verified through an ablation study so that the advantage of the multimodal approach can be demonstrated empirically against the unimodal text and visual baselines. 3. analysis.research_question_and_background: Dengue hemorrhagic fever remains a critical public health concern in Indonesia, and YouTube has become a major channel for health information. Identifying influential actors is essential for public health communication, yet existing social network analysis relies on text and ignores visual signals such as video thumbnails.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This study used an ablation study with stratified five-fold cross-validation on 33,233 Indonesian comments from 5,365 videos across 1,129 collected channels (1,084 retained after language filtering) over 2021 to 2025.
analysis.methods: Textual features from IndoBERT and visual features from ResNet-50 are fused adaptively per dimension, aggregated per channel, and used to build a content-based co-audience network analysed with PageRank.
analysis.main_results: The fused representation reached 79.52 percent accuracy and 78.42 percent macro F1, outperforming text and visual baselines. KOMPASTV, Kata Dokter, and Halodoc emerged as the most influential actors.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The study introduces a multimodal framework that combines text and visual features for identifying influential actors in dengue hemorrhagic fever information dissemination on YouTube, demonstrating improved performance over single-modal approaches.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform targeted public health communication strategies by identifying key influencers on YouTube who disseminate information about dengue hemorrhagic fever, potentially improving the reach and effectiveness of health messaging.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to YouTube comments in Indonesian and relies on self-reported data, which may introduce bias. The evidence strength is moderate due to the reliance on a single data source and the absence of biological or clinical validation.

analysis.summary_en: This study addresses the need for improved identification of influential actors in public health communication related to dengue hemorrhagic fever on YouTube. It proposes a multimodal framework combining text and visual features using IndoBERT and ResNet-50 models, with an ablation study showing 79.52 percent accuracy and 78.42 percent macro F1. The framework identifies KOMPASTV, Kata Dokter, and Halodoc as the most influential actors. The study's significance lies in its potential to enhance health messaging strategies by targeting key influencers. However, the reliance on YouTube comments in Indonesian and the absence of biological validation limit the evidence strength, which is assessed as moderate.

analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究使用了2021年至2025年间从1129个收集的频道(语言过滤后保留1084个)中获取的5365个视频的33233条印尼语评论,进行了分层五折交叉验证的消融研究。
analysis_zh.methods: 通过IndoBERT提取文本特征,通过ResNet-50提取视觉特征,然后按维度自适应融合,按通道聚合,并用于构建基于内容的共受众网络,通过PageRank进行分析。
analysis_zh.main_results: 融合表示方法达到了79.52百分比的准确率和78.42百分比的宏F1值,优于文本和视觉基线。KOMPASTV、Kata Dokter和Halodoc成为最具影响力的行动者。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 本研究引入了一种结合文本和视觉特征的多模态框架,用于识别YouTube上登革热出血热信息传播中的有影响力人物,展示了其优于单模态方法的性能。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以通过识别在YouTube上传播登革热出血热信息的关键影响者,为有针对性的公共卫生传播策略提供信息,从而潜在提高健康信息的传播范围和效果。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究仅限于印尼语的YouTube评论,并依赖于自我报告数据,这可能引入偏差。由于依赖单一数据源且缺乏生物学或临床验证,证据强度中等。

papers.title: Environmental BPA exposure promotes flavivirus replication and extends mosquito lifespan.
papers.abstract: Environmental exposure to endocrine-disrupting chemicals (EDCs) is widespread, yet their influence on arthropod-borne virus transmission remains poorly understood. Here, we show that bisphenol A (BPA), a common EDC, enhances the replication of Zika virus (ZIKV) and Dengue virus (DENV) in the mosquito Aedes aegypti by modulating host oxidative stress responses. Through systematic screening of nine EDCs, BPA and dichlorodiphenyltrichloroethane (DDT), significantly promoted viral replication, with BPA exhibiting the strongest effect. Chronic larval exposure to BPA led to its residual accumulation in adults and increased susceptibility to viral infection. Transcriptomic and biochemical analyses revealed that BPA upregulates antioxidant enzymes-superoxide dismutase (SOD) and catalase (CAT)-and reduces lipid peroxidation, thereby alleviating oxidative stress and creating a cellular environment conducive to viral replication. Furthermore, BPA extended the lifespan of ZIKV-infected mosquitoes, potentially extending the period during which infected mosquitoes could transmit virus, although this remains to be directly demonstrated. Our findings uncover a mechanism by which environmental BPA exposure may influence flavivirus transmission dynamics through redox modulation in mosquitoes, highlighting the need to incorporate pollutant impacts into arboviral risk assessments.
papers.journal: Comparative biochemistry and physiology. Toxicology & pharmacology : CBP

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the impact of environmental bisphenol A (BPA) exposure on Dengue virus (DENV) and Zika virus (ZIKV) replication in Aedes aegypti mosquitoes. The research highlights that BPA enhances viral replication by modulating oxidative stress responses, as evidenced by upregulation of antioxidant enzymes and reduction in lipid peroxidation. Additionally, BPA exposure increases mosquito lifespan, potentially prolonging the transmission period. The findings suggest that BPA may influence flavivirus transmission dynamics through redox modulation, emphasizing the importance of considering environmental pollutants in arboviral risk assessments. However, the study does not directly demonstrate the effect of BPA on DENV transmission, and further research is needed to confirm these implications for Dengue virus specifically.

papers.title_zh: 环境BPA暴露促进黄病毒复制并延长蚊虫寿命。
papers.source_body_en: Environmental exposure to endocrine-disrupting chemicals (EDCs) is widespread, yet their influence on arthropod-borne virus transmission remains poorly understood. Here, we show that bisphenol A (BPA), a common EDC, enhances the replication of Zika virus (ZIKV) and Dengue virus (DENV) in the mosquito Aedes aegypti by modulating host oxidative stress responses. Through systematic screening of nine EDCs, BPA and dichlorodiphenyltrichloroethane (DDT), significantly promoted viral replication, with BPA exhibiting the strongest effect. Chronic larval exposure to BPA led to its residual accumulation in adults and increased susceptibility to viral infection. Transcriptomic and biochemical analyses revealed that BPA upregulates antioxidant enzymes-superoxide dismutase (SOD) and catalase (CAT)-and reduces lipid peroxidation, thereby alleviating oxidative stress and creating a cellular environment conducive to viral replication. Furthermore, BPA extended the lifespan of ZIKV-infected mosquitoes, potentially extending the period during which infected mosquitoes could transmit virus, although this remains to be directly demonstrated. Our findings uncover a mechanism by which environmental BPA exposure may influence flavivirus transmission dynamics through redox modulation in mosquitoes, highlighting the need to incorporate pollutant impacts into arboviral risk assessments.

papers.title: Clinical and epidemiological characteristics of dengue with warning signs among hospitalized children in Vietnam: A cross-sectional study.
papers.abstract: ObjectiveDengue is a major vector-borne viral infection and a frequent cause of pediatric hospitalization in endemic settings. This study described the clinical and laboratory characteristics of hospitalized children with laboratory-confirmed dengue in northern Vietnam and examined factors associated with dengue with warning signs (DWS).MethodsThis hospital-based cross-sectional study included retrospective and prospective components. Medical records were retrospectively reviewed for eligible children aged 0-16 years admitted from 1 September to 29 December 2022, whereas eligible children in the same age group were prospectively enrolled from 30 December 2022 to 31 August 2023. DWS was classified according to the World Health Organization 2009 criteria and the Vietnamese Ministry of Health guideline. Multivariable logistic regression was used to identify factors associated with DWS.ResultsAmong 319 children, 126 (39.5%) met the criteria for DWS. In the multivariable analysis, age >10 years (adjusted odds ratio [aOR] 2.17, 95% confidence interval [CI] 1.28-3.66; p = 0.004), urban residence (aOR 2.88, 95% CI 1.27-6.51; p = 0.011), platelet count ≤100 × 109/L (aOR 3.34, 95% CI 1.86-5.97; p < 0.001), and AST ≥100 U/L (aOR 2.83, 95% CI 1.58-5.05; p < 0.001) were independently associated with DWS. Among children with DWS, the most frequently observed warning signs were abdominal pain or tenderness (64.3%), persistent vomiting (31.7%), and mucosal bleeding (25.4%).ConclusionsDWS was common among hospitalized children with dengue at a tertiary children's hospital in northern Vietnam. Older age, urban residence, thrombocytopenia, and elevated aspartate aminotransferase may help identify children who require closer monitoring during hospitalization.

papers.title: Community-based health education improves knowledge of dengue hemorrhagic fever prevention: evidence from a pre–post intervention in indonesia
papers.abstract: Background: Dengue Hemorrhagic Fever (DHF) remains a major public health challenge in Indonesia, requiring effective community-based preventive strategies. Health education is considered a key intervention for improving public awareness and promoting sustainable dengue prevention practices. This study aimed to evaluate the effectiveness of a community health education program in improving knowledge regarding DHF prevention among residents in the working area of UPTD Puskesmas Mekar Sari. Methods: A community-based pre-experimental study using a one-group pre-test and post-test design was conducted among 37 community members. The intervention consisted of a 90-minute health education session delivered through lectures, interactive discussions, demonstrations, and educational leaflets emphasizing the PSN 3M Plus strategy. Participants completed identical knowledge questionnaires before and immediately after the intervention. Descriptive statistics were used to summarize changes in knowledge scores. Results: Before the intervention, 70.3% of participants had poor knowledge and 29.7% had fair knowledge, while none achieved a good knowledge level. Following the intervention, all participants (100%) attained the good knowledge category. The mean knowledge score increased from 8.00 to 12.89, with an average improvement of 4.89 points, indicating a substantial enhancement in participants' understanding of dengue transmission, symptoms, and prevention. Conclusion: Community-based health education effectively improved knowledge of DHF prevention and reinforced community awareness of the PSN 3M Plus strategy. Integrating regular educational activities into primary healthcare programs may strengthen community participation and contribute to sustainable dengue prevention efforts.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景:登革出血热(DHF)仍然是印度尼西亚公共卫生的主要挑战,需要有效的基于社区的预防策略。健康教育被认为是提高公众意识和促进可持续登革热预防实践的关键干预措施。本研究旨在评估一项基于社区的健康教育计划在改善UPTD Puskesmas Mekar Sari工作区域居民对DHF预防知识方面的有效性。方法:在37名社区成员中开展了一项基于社区的前实验研究,采用单组前后测设计。干预包括通过讲座、互动讨论、演示和强调PSN 3M Plus策略的教育传单进行的90分钟健康教育课程。参与者在干预前后完成了相同的知识问卷。使用描述性统计方法总结知识得分的变化。结果:干预前,70.3%的参与者知识水平较差,29.7%的知识水平一般,而没有人达到良好的知识水平。干预后,所有参与者(100%)均达到良好的知识水平。平均知识得分从8.00提高到12.89,平均提高了4.89分,表明参与者对登革热(传播)、症状和预防的理解有了显著增强。结论:基于社区的健康教育有效提高了DHF预防知识,并加强了社区对PSN 3M Plus策略的认识。将定期教育活动整合到初级卫生保健计划中可能增强社区参与度,并有助于可持续的登革热预防工作。

papers.title: Environmental drivers and spatiotemporal heterogeneity of dengue attack rates across selected Yemeni governorates using spatial autocorrelation and environmental discordance analysis
papers.abstract: Dengue is environmentally sensitive, yet broad environmental conditions may not consistently correspond with reported disease burden, particularly in conflict-affected settings where surveillance capacity may vary. This ecological longitudinal study examined the spatiotemporal relationships between environmental conditions and annual reported dengue attack rates across ten Yemeni governorates from 2020 to 2024. Annual reported dengue attack rates were standardised and evaluated using temporal rankings, trajectory classifications, an exploratory Dengue Instability Index, Spearman rank correlations and Kendall’s coefficient of concordance. Environmental conditions were characterised using vegetation, surface-water, land-surface-temperature and precipitation indicators. Global and local Moran statistics were used to assess spatial dependence and environmental–epidemiological spatial associations, while principal component analysis (PCA) integrated the environmental indicators into a common environmental-profile gradient for evaluating environmental–epidemiological concordance and discordance. Marked spatial and temporal heterogeneity was observed in reported dengue burden. The highest-burden governorate changed annually, although Shabwah and Abyan maintained persistently elevated relative burdens. Hadramaut recorded the greatest temporal instability, followed by Marib and Abyan. Governorate rankings nevertheless demonstrated moderate overall concordance across the study period (Kendall’s W = 0.677, χ2(9) = 30.47, p < 0.001). Global univariate Moran’s III values were consistently negative, with significant spatial dispersion detected only in 2021 ( I = − 0.421, p < 0.05). Bivariate spatial associations between dengue and individual environmental indicators were predominantly weak, negative and temporally inconsistent. Principal component analysis showed that the first environmental component explained 67.2% of the standardised variance and represented an integrated environmental profile (a gradient from hotter, drier and less vegetated to cooler, wetter and more vegetated conditions). Among 20 governorate–year observations with above-mean reported dengue attack rates, 17 (85%) occurred under below-mean environmental-profile conditions. These findings demonstrate substantial environmental–epidemiological discordance in Yemen. Broad remotely sensed environmental conditions alone were insufficient to explain the spatial and temporal distribution of reported dengue burden. Operationally, remotely sensed environmental indicators could complement reported dengue notifications and locally available entomological and contextual data to prioritise governorates for intensified surveillance and targeted investigation.

The research employed ecological longitudinal methods, standardising dengue attack rates and evaluating them using statistical techniques such as Spearman rank correlations and Kendall’s coefficient of concordance. Environmental indicators included vegetation, surface-water, land-surface-temperature, and precipitation. Results showed marked spatial and temporal variability in dengue burden, with some governorates consistently reporting higher rates. The study found that environmental conditions alone could not fully explain the distribution of dengue cases, suggesting the need for integrated data approaches. These findings have implications for improving surveillance and targeting interventions in high-risk areas. However, the study's reliance on reported data introduces limitations, and the evidence is moderate due to the absence of direct causality.

papers.abstract_zh: 登革热对环境具有敏感性,但在冲突影响的环境中,由于监测能力可能不一致,广泛环境条件可能无法始终与报告的疾病负担相对应。本生态纵向研究分析了2020年至2024年间也门十个省份的环境条件与年度报告登革热攻击率之间的时空关系。年度报告的登革热攻击率通过时间排名、轨迹分类、探索性登革热不稳定性指数、斯皮尔曼等级相关和肯德尔一致性系数进行标准化和评估。环境条件通过植被、地表水、地表温度和降水量指标进行表征。全球和局部莫兰统计量用于评估空间依赖性和环境-流行病学空间关联,而主成分分析(PCA)将环境指标整合为一个共同的环境特征梯度,以评估环境-流行病学的一致性和不一致。在报告的登革热负担中观察到显著的空间和时间异质性。最高负担省份每年变化,尽管沙布瓦和阿比安保持了持续较高的相对负担。哈德拉毛省记录了最大的时间不稳定性,其次是马里布和阿比安。然而,省份排名在整个研究期间显示出中等程度的整体一致性(肯德尔W = 0.677,χ2(9) = 30.47,p < 0.001)。全球单变量莫兰III值始终为负,仅在2021年检测到显著的空间分散(I = −0.421,p < 0.05)。登革热与单个环境指标之间的双变量空间关联主要为弱、负相关且时间不一致。主成分分析显示,第一环境成分解释了标准化方差的67.2%,代表了一个整合的环境特征(从较热、较干燥和植被较少的条件到较冷、较湿润和植被较多的条件的梯度)。在20个高于平均报告登革热攻击率的省份-年观察中,有17个(85%)发生在环境特征低于平均的条件下。这些发现表明也门存在显著的环境-流行病学不一致。仅靠广泛的遥感环境条件不足以解释报告登革热负担的空间和时间分布。在实际操作中,遥感环境指标可以补充报告的登革热通知和当地可用的媒介学和背景数据,以优先考虑需要加强监测和针对性调查的省份。

analysis_zh.methods: 年度登革热攻击率通过时间排名、轨迹分类、登革热不稳定性指数、斯皮尔曼等级相关和肯德尔一致性系数进行标准化和评估。环境条件通过植被、地表水、地表温度和降水量指标进行表征。
analysis_zh.main_results: 在报告的登革热负担中观察到显著的空间和时间异质性。最高负担省份每年变化,尽管沙布瓦和阿比安保持了持续较高的相对负担。哈德拉毛省记录了最大的时间不稳定性,其次是马里布和阿比安。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现表明也门存在显著的环境-流行病学不一致,表明仅靠广泛的环境条件不足以解释登革热负担的分布。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果表明,遥感环境指标可以补充报告的登革热通知和当地可用数据,以优先考虑需要加强监测和针对性调查的省份。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性在于其依赖于报告的登革热攻击率,这些数据可能因监测能力的差异而存在变异性。证据强度中等,因为这些发现强调了不一致,但并未建立直接的因果关系。

papers.title: Gambaran Hasil Pemeriksaan Jumlah Trombosit dan Hematokrit Pada Pasien Dengue Di Puskesmas Ngaglik 1
papers.abstract: Demam berdarah dengue, yang disebabkan oleh virus dengue, tetap menjadi tantangan kesehatan masyarakat yang signifikan di Indonesia. Tes laboratorium, seperti penghitungan trombosit dan pengukuran hematokrit, sangat penting untuk mendiagnosis dan memantau pasien demam berdarah. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk menyelidiki hasil pengujian penghitungan trombosit dan hematokrit pada pasien demam berdarah di Puskesmas Ngaglik. Jenis penelitian ini adalah kuantitatif deskriptif. Pengambilan sampel total digunakan untuk mengumpulkan 135 catatan pasien demam berdarah yang diperoleh dari data laboratorium sekunder pada tahun 2025. Analisis data dilakukan menggunakan metode univariat dan disajikan dalam bentuk distribusi frekuensi dan persentase. Temuan menunjukkan bahwa mayoritas pasien demam berdarah adalah dewasa, dengan 91 responden (67,4%), dan 77 responden (57,0%) adalah laki-laki. Analisis penghitungan trombosit mengungkapkan bahwa sebagian besar pasien mengalami trombositopenia, yaitu 110 peserta (81,5%), sedangkan 25 peserta (18,5%) memiliki nilai normal. Selanjutnya, analisis kadar hematokrit menunjukkan bahwa sebagian besar pasien memiliki hematokrit dalam kisaran normal, yaitu 68 peserta (50,4%), diikuti oleh 37 peserta (27,4%) dengan hematokrit rendah dan 30 peserta (22,2%) dengan hematokrit tinggi. Penelitian ini menunjukkan bahwa trombositopenia merupakan gangguan hematologis yang paling umum terjadi pada pasien demam berdarah, sementara fluktuasi kadar hematokrit mencerminkan kondisi klinis dan tahap penyakit.

papers.title: DENGUE (DENV)
papers.abstract: INTRODUÇÃOA dengue é uma doença antiga, com registros históricos que antecedem a consolidação da medicina moderna.O primeiro relato de uma enfermidade clinicamente compatível com a dengue foi identificado em uma enciclopédia médica chinesa datada de 992 d.C., durante a Dinastia Northern Song.Esse compêndio reunia descrições de diversas doenças e sintomas, incluindo quadros caracterizados por febre aguda, dores corporais intensas e associação com "insetos que voam próximos à água", elementos que, à luz do conhecimento atual, são compatíveis com a infecção pelo vírus da dengue e sua transmissão por mosquitos hematófagos (Gubler, 2006).A história da dengue está intrinsecamente relacionada à de seu principal vetor, o mosquito Aedes aegypti, responsável pela disseminação do vírus em diferentes regiões do mundo.A expansão do colonialismo europeu, associada ao crescimento da indústria naval global entre os séculos XVIII e XIX, desempenhou papel central nesse processo.O aumento das rotas marítimas e o surgimento e fortalecimento de cidades portuárias criaram condições ambientais favoráveis à proliferação do vetor, como o acúmulo de água em recipientes artificiais e a intensa circulação de pessoas e mercadorias (Gubler, 2011;Messina et al., 2014).O tráfico transatlântico de pessoas escravizadas conectou a África, considerada a região de origem do Aedes aegypti e dos vírus a ele associados, a diversas partes do mundo, especialmente às Américas (Do Carmo, 2025).O mosquito e o vírus teriam sido introduzidos no continente americano principalmente por meio de ovos transportados em navios negreiros, aderidos a recipientes que acumulavam água durante as longas travessias oceânicas.Nas Américas, a primeira descrição formal do mosquito data de 1762.Contudo, relatos médicos sobre uma das principais doenças transmitidas por sua picada, a dengue, já haviam sido registrados no século XVI, quando a enfermidade era conhecida como "febre quebra-ossos", em referência às intensas dores musculares e articulares que caracterizam o quadro clínico (Gubler, 2006).Em 1780, foi descrito um surto de dengue na cidade da Filadélfia, nos Estados Unidos.No mesmo período, registros de surtos na Ásia e na África confirmaram a ampla disseminação do vetor pelos trópicos, configurando o que é considerado o primeiro surto multicontinental da doença.Ao longo dos séculos seguintes, a dengue consolidou-se como um problema recorrente em regiões tropicais e subtropicais, acompanhando a expansão urbana, o crescimento populacional e as transformações ambientais (Gubler, 2006;Messina et al., 2014).No Brasil, o primeiro registro documentado de dengue ocorreu em 1916, na cidade de São Paulo.Entretanto, apenas décadas depois o país enfrentaria uma epidemia reconhecida da doença.Em 1981, casos de febre foram notificados em Boa Vista, no estado de Roraima, e posteriormente confirmados como dengue por virologistas do Instituto Evandro Chagas (IEC).Entre julho de 1981 e agosto de 1982, aproximadamente 11 mil pessoas foram infectadas pelos sorotipos 1 e 4 do vírus da dengue.Evidências epidemiológicas indicam que o vírus tenha ingressado no território brasileiro por via terrestre, com origem no Caribe e no norte da América do Sul (Teixeira; Barreto; Guerra, 2009; Brasil, 2022).Nesse período inicial, não houve disseminação nacional da doença, uma vez que o Aedes aegypti ainda não se encontrava amplamente disperso no país.Ademais, as ações de controle vetorial implementadas contribuíram para a contenção do surto na região, sem impedir, contudo, a manutenção do vetor em outras áreas do país.No entanto, alguns anos depois, em 30 de abril de 1986, os primeiros casos de dengue foram registrados em Nova Iguaçu, no estado do Rio de Janeiro, marcando o início de um novo ciclo de expansão da doença no território nacional.Diante desse cenário, o Centro de Estudos da Escola Nacional de Saúde Pública da Fundação Oswaldo Cruz (Ensp/Fiocruz) promoveu um debate acadêmico sobre a dengue, posteriormente transcrito e publicado em um dossiê
authors: Ana Madalena dos Santos Silva Brito
Alexandre Muller Zigmundo da Silva Leite

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to explore the historical context and spread of dengue virus, particularly focusing on its introduction to Brazil and the role of the Aedes aegypti mosquito in its dissemination. Dengue is an ancient disease with historical records dating back to the 10th century, and its transmission has been closely linked to the movement of the vector and the virus across continents.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study is a historical review focusing on the spread of dengue virus and its vector, Aedes aegypti, across different regions, including Brazil. It examines the introduction of the virus to Brazil in the early 20th century and the subsequent epidemiological patterns observed in the 1980s.
analysis.methods: The study utilized historical records, epidemiological data, and references to prior research to trace the introduction and spread of dengue virus in Brazil. It analyzed the role of colonialism, maritime trade, and the movement of the Aedes aegypti mosquito in facilitating the virus's dissemination.
analysis.main_results: The first documented case of dengue in Brazil occurred in 1916 in São Paulo, but the country did not experience a recognized epidemic until 1981 in Boa Vista, Roraima. By 1982, approximately 11,000 people were infected with DENV-1 and DENV-4. The virus was later introduced to Rio de Janeiro in 1986, marking the beginning of a new phase of its spread in the country.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret that the introduction of dengue to Brazil was influenced by historical factors such as colonial expansion and maritime trade, which facilitated the spread of the Aedes aegypti mosquito and the virus. This study provides a historical perspective on the epidemiology of dengue in Brazil.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings highlight the historical and ecological factors that contributed to the spread of dengue in Brazil, offering insights into the disease's epidemiological patterns and the importance of vector control in preventing outbreaks.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is based on historical and epidemiological records, which may be subject to gaps or inaccuracies. However, the evidence is supported by multiple references, including documented cases and historical accounts, providing a moderate level of confidence in its conclusions.

analysis.summary_en: This study provides a historical overview of dengue virus and its spread, particularly in Brazil. It traces the origins of dengue to ancient times, with the first documented case in Brazil occurring in 1916. The virus was later confirmed in 1981, with approximately 11,000 infections reported in Roraima. The introduction of dengue to Brazil is linked to the movement of the Aedes aegypti mosquito, facilitated by colonial expansion and maritime trade. The study emphasizes the role of vector control in managing outbreaks and offers a historical perspective on the epidemiology of dengue in the country. While the evidence is based on historical records, it is supported by multiple references, providing a moderate level of confidence in its conclusions.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在探讨 登革病毒 的历史背景及其传播,特别是其引入巴西的过程以及埃及伊蚊(Aedes aegypti)在传播中的作用。登革热是一种历史悠久的疾病,其历史记录可追溯至10世纪,且其传播与 传播 的传播及病毒在大陆间的移动密切相关。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究是一项历史回顾,重点分析 登革病毒 及其媒介 Aedes aegypti 在不同地区的传播,包括巴西。研究探讨了该病毒在20世纪初传入巴西的情况,以及1980年代在该国观察到的流行病学模式。
elements_zh.methods: 本研究利用历史记录、流行病学数据和先前研究的参考文献,追踪登革热病毒在巴西的引入和传播过程。研究分析了殖民扩张、海上贸易以及埃及伊蚊传播的动态如何促进病毒的扩散。
elements_zh.main_results: 巴西首个有记录的登革热病例出现在1916年,地点是圣保罗市。然而,该国直到1981年罗赖马州的博阿维斯塔市才出现公认的登革热疫情。到1982年,大约有11,000人感染了登革病毒1型和4型。随后,该病毒于1986年传入里约热内卢州的新伊瓜苏市,标志着其在巴西国内传播进入了一个新的阶段。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者认为,登革热传入巴西受到历史因素的影响,如殖民扩张和海上贸易,这些因素促进了埃及伊蚊和病毒的传播。本研究为登革热在巴西的传播提供了历史视角。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果突显了历史和生态因素在巴西登革热传播中的作用,为理解该疾病的流行病学模式提供了见解,并强调了埃及伊蚊控制在预防疾病传播中的重要性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究基于历史和流行病学记录,这些记录可能存在缺失或不准确之处。然而,研究结果得到了多个参考文献的支持,包括有记录的病例和历史记载,从而对其结论提供了中等程度的可信度。

analysis_zh.main_results: 巴西首个有记录的登革热病例出现在1916年,地点是圣保罗市。然而,该国直到1981年罗赖马州的博阿维斯塔市才出现公认的登革热疫情。到1982年,大约有11,000人感染了登革病毒1型和4型。随后,该病毒于1986年传入里约热内卢州的新伊瓜苏市,标志着其在巴西国内传播进入了一个新的阶段。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者认为,登革热传入巴西受到历史因素的影响,如殖民扩张和海上贸易,这些因素促进了埃及伊蚊和病毒的传播。本研究为登革热在巴西的传播提供了历史视角。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果突显了历史和生态因素在巴西登革热传播中的作用,为理解该疾病的流行病学模式提供了见解,并强调了埃及伊蚊控制在预防疾病传播中的重要性。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究基于历史和流行病学记录,这些记录可能存在缺失或不准确之处。然而,研究结果得到了多个参考文献的支持,包括有记录的病例和历史记载,从而对其结论提供了中等程度的可信度。

papers.title: Synergistic Effects of pH and Temperature on Dengue Virus Envelope Dimers: Insights from Microsecond Molecular Dynamics Simulations
papers.abstract: Abstract Dengue pathogenesis depends on a conformational rearrangement of the envelope glycoprotein (pE) induced by low pH. However, how pH and temperature cooperate to destabilize the dimeric form of the pE, a fundamental step that enables the formation of the fusion-active trimer, remains unclear. Here, we investigate this synergy for Dengue serotypes of greatest medical relevance, DENV-2 and DENV-3. All–atom molecular dynamics simulations were performed on the microsecond scale, at 28 °C, 37 °C, and 40 °C under pH 5, 6, and 7 using CHARMM36m force fields and complemented by extended coarse-grained molecular dynamics simulations for the DENV-2 system at 37 °C and pH 5, and for the DENV-3 system at 28 °C and pH 5, and at 37 °C and pH 7. Our simulations suggest that increasing the temperature from 28 to 37 °C tends to expand the conformational space at neutral pH, potentially weakening dimer integrity through modulation of the interfacial interaction network. Acidification appears to amplify this effect in a serotype–specific manner: in our simulations DENV-2 required pH 5, while DENV-3 responded at pH 6. Additionally, distance and principal component analyses revealed an asymmetric dissociation pathway, termed the “compensatory embrace”, observed in both all-atom and coarse-grained models. Structural analyses further highlighted the differences in histidine distribution between the serotypes. Moreover, interaction mapping at 37 °C identified candidate interfacial contacts that may act as pH-sensitive latches, maintaining stability at pH 7 but breaking upon acidification. Collectively, these results suggest a potential hierarchy of physicochemical triggers that may contribute to the conversion of dimer into fusion-competent monomers. These interfacial hotspots and the “compensatory embrace” constitute structurally informed targets that, pending validation under native virion conditions, may guide the rational design of antivirals and immunogens, underscoring the value of long-time scale molecular dynamics simulations as a hypothesis-generating tool in drug discovery.
papers.journal: Journal of Chemical Information and Modeling

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the synergistic effects of pH and temperature on the destabilization of the dimeric form of the Dengue virus envelope glycoprotein, a key step in viral pathogenesis. Using all-atom and coarse-grained molecular dynamics simulations, the researchers explored how varying pH and temperature conditions affect the conformational stability of DENV-2 and DENV-3. The results indicate that temperature increases at neutral pH may weaken dimer integrity, with acidification amplifying this effect in a serotype-specific manner. An asymmetric dissociation pathway, termed the "compensatory embrace", was identified. These findings highlight potential physicochemical triggers for dimer-to-monomer conversion and suggest structural targets for antiviral and immunogen development. However, the study is limited to computational models and lacks experimental validation under native virion conditions, resulting in moderate evidence strength.

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 登革病毒发病机制依赖于包膜糖蛋白(pE)在低pH诱导下的构象重排。然而,pH和温度如何协同作用以破坏pE的二聚体形式,这是形成融合活性三聚体的关键步骤,目前尚不清楚。在此研究中,我们针对具有最大医学意义的登革病毒血清型,DENV-2和DENV-3,探讨了这种协同效应。使用CHARMM36m力场,在28 °C、37 °C和40 °C下,pH 5、6和7条件下进行了全原子分子动力学模拟,并通过扩展粗粒度分子动力学模拟补充了DENV-2系统在37 °C和pH 5下的模拟,以及DENV-3系统在28 °C和pH 5、37 °C和pH 7下的模拟。我们的模拟结果表明,温度从28 °C升高到37 °C时,在中性pH条件下会扩大构象空间,可能通过调节界面相互作用网络而削弱二聚体的完整性。酸化似乎以血清型特异性方式放大了这一效应:在我们的模拟中,DENV-2需要pH 5,而DENV-3则在pH 6时响应。此外,距离分析和主成分分析揭示了一种不对称的解离路径,称为“补偿性拥抱”,在全原子和粗粒度模型中均观察到。结构分析进一步突出了不同血清型之间组氨酸分布的差异。此外,在37 °C下的相互作用图谱识别出了一些候选的界面接触点,这些接触点可能作为pH敏感的闩锁,维持在pH 7时的稳定性,但在酸化条件下会断裂。总体而言,这些结果表明可能存在一种物理化学触发因素的层次结构,这可能有助于二聚体转化为具有融合能力的单体。这些界面热点以及“补偿性拥抱”构成了结构导向的目标,若在原生病毒颗粒条件下得到验证,可能有助于抗病毒药物和免疫原的合理设计,强调了在药物发现中长时尺度分子动力学模拟作为假设生成工具的价值。

papers.title: Dengue and Chikungunya Seroprevalence in an Urban Low-Income Cohort in Delhi: A Cross-Sectional and Nested Longitudinal Study
papers.abstract: Objectives: The aim of this study was to ascertain the seroprevalence and determinants of dengue virus (DENV) and chikungunya virus (CHIKV) seropositivity in Delhi, India. Methods: This cross-sectional serosurvey with a nested longitudinal immunological sub-study was conducted in an urban resettlement and slum settlement in the North-East district of Delhi in individuals aged ≥2 years. Dengue and Chikungunya virus IgG antibodies were screened using indirect enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA), and a longitudinal subset of 100 paired IgG-seropositive samples was further characterized via a plaque reduction neutralization test (μPRNT50) to evaluate changes in functional neutralization over time. Results: A total of 752 participants, including 56.65% female participants, were included in the study. Of the participants studied, 81.91% (95% CI: 78.97, 84.60; n = 616) were positive for IgG antibodies against DENV, and 28.32% (95% CI: 25.13, 31.69; n = 213) were positive for CHIKV IgG antibodies. μPRNT50 confirmed stable, near-universal CHIKV neutralization (97% baseline, 98% endline). However, DENV neutralizing antibody showed a significant contraction for DENV-3 (79% baseline, 60% endline) and DENV-4 (69% baseline, 60% endline), while DENV-1 (76%) and DENV-2 (77% to 80%) antibodies remained stable. papers.title: Platelet Indices in Dengue Patients Stratified by Platelet Count in a Tertiary Care Hospital of Khulna City of Bangladesh
papers.abstract: Background: Dengue fever is a major public health problem in tropical countries and is commonly associated with hematological abnormalities, particularly thrombocytopenia. Platelet indices such as mean platelet volume (MPV), platelet distribution width (PDW), and plateletcrit (PCT) are routinely available parameters that may help in assessing disease severity and monitoring patients with dengue infection.Objective: The purpose of the present study was to evaluate platelet indices in dengue patients stratified according to platelet count in a tertiary care hospital in Khulna, Bangladesh. Methodology: This cross-sectional study was conducted at Gazi Medical College Hospital, Khulna, Bangladesh from August to December 2025. A total of 100 serologically confirmed dengue patients aged more than or equal to 18 years were enrolled. Patients were categorized into groups based on platelet count, such as less than 20,000/cumm, 20,000 to 50,000/cumm, 50,000 to 100,000/cumm, 100,000 to 150,000/cumm, and more than 150,000/cumm. Hematological parameters, including platelet count, MPV, PDW, and PCT, were obtained using an automated hematology analyzer. Data were analyzed using SPSS version 21. As data were non-normally distributed, results were expressed as median (IQR), and comparisons among groups were performed using the Kruskal–Wallis test. Results: Among the 100 patients, 55.0% were male and 45% female. The majority of the patients were recorded in the 31 to 40 years age group (28.0%), followed closely by the 21 to 30 years age group (26.0%). Most cases were dengue fever (79.0%), followed by dengue hemorrhagic fever (18.0%) and dengue shock syndrome (3.0%). The median platelet count was 57,500/cumm (IQR: 30,000–89,750). Plateletcrit showed a highly significant association with platelet count (p < 0.001), with progressively increasing values across higher platelet count groups. In contrast, MPV (p = 0.306) and PDW (p = 0.302) did not show significant associations with platelet count. Conclusion: Among the platelet indices, plateletcrit demonstrated a strong and significant correlation with platelet count in dengue patients. Plateletcrit may serve as a useful adjunct parameter in monitoring thrombocytopenia and disease progression in dengue infection. Bangladesh Journal of Infectious Diseases, June 2026;13(1):360-366

analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to evaluate platelet indices in dengue patients stratified by platelet count in a tertiary care hospital in Khulna, Bangladesh. A cross-sectional design was used, enrolling 100 serologically confirmed dengue patients aged 18 years or older. Platelet indices such as mean platelet volume (MPV), platelet distribution width (PDW), and plateletcrit (PCT) were measured using an automated hematology analyzer. The median platelet count was 57,500/cumm (IQR: 30,000–89,750), with 79% of cases classified as dengue fever, 18% as dengue hemorrhagic fever, and 3% as dengue shock syndrome. Plateletcrit showed a highly significant association with platelet count (p < 0.001), while MPV and PDW did not. The authors concluded that plateletcrit is a strong and significant correlate of platelet count in dengue patients, suggesting its potential utility in monitoring disease progression. The study is limited by its cross-sectional design and the absence of detailed limitations or evidence strength assessment.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 登革热是热带国家的主要公共卫生问题,常与血液学异常,特别是血小板减少症相关。本研究的目的是评估孟加拉国库尔纳市三级医院中按血小板计数分层的登革热患者的血小板指标。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本横断面研究于2025年8月至12月在孟加拉国库尔纳市的Gazi Medical College Hospital进行。共纳入100例血清学确诊的登革热患者,年龄均大于或等于18岁。根据血小板计数将患者分为不同组别,如每微升少于20,000个、20,000至50,000个、50,000至100,000个、100,000至150,000个以及超过150,000个。
elements_zh.methods: 使用自动化血液分析仪获取血液学参数,包括血小板计数、平均血小板体积(MPV)、血小板分布宽度(PDW)和血小板压积(PCT)。数据使用SPSS 21版进行分析。由于数据呈非正态分布,结果以中位数(IQR)表示,组间比较采用Kruskal–Wallis检验。
elements_zh.main_results: 在100名患者中,55.0%为男性,45%为女性。大多数患者年龄在31至40岁之间(28.0%),其次是21至30岁(26.0%)。大多数病例为登革热(79.0%),其次是登革出血热(18.0%)和登革休克综合征(3.0%)。血小板计数的中位数为57,500/cumm(IQR:30,000–89,750)。血小板压积与血小板计数之间存在高度显著关联(p < 0.001),在血小板计数较高的组别中呈现逐渐增加的趋势。相比之下,MPV(p = 0.306)和PDW(p = 0.302)与血小板计数之间未显示出显著关联。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 在血小板指标中,血小板压积在登革热患者中与血小板计数表现出强而显著的相关性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 血小板压积可能作为监测登革热感染中血小板减少症和疾病进展的有用辅助参数。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 所提供的证据并未报告局限性或证据强度。

Patients were categorized into groups based on platelet count, such as less than 20,000/cumm, 20,000 to 50,000/cumm, 50,000 to 100,000/cumm, 100,000 to 150,000/cumm, and more than 150,000/cumm. Hematological parameters, including platelet count, MPV, PDW, and PCT, were obtained using an automated hematology analyzer. Data were analyzed using SPSS version 21. As data were non-normally distributed, results were expressed as median (IQR), and comparisons among groups were performed using the Kruskal–Wallis test. Results: Among the 100 patients, 55.0% were male and 45% female. The majority of the patients were recorded in the 31 to 40 years age group (28.0%), followed closely by the 21 to 30 years age group (26.0%). Most cases were dengue fever (79.0%), followed by dengue hemorrhagic fever (18.0%) and dengue shock syndrome (3.0%). The median platelet count was 57,500/cumm (IQR: 30,000–89,750). Plateletcrit showed a highly significant association with platelet count (p < 0.001), with progressively increasing values across higher platelet count groups. In contrast, MPV (p = 0.306) and PDW (p = 0.302) did not show significant associations with platelet count. Conclusion: Among the platelet indices, plateletcrit demonstrated a strong and significant correlation with platelet count in dengue patients. Plateletcrit may serve as a useful adjunct parameter in monitoring thrombocytopenia and disease progression in dengue infection. Bangladesh Journal of Infectious Diseases, June 2026;13(1):360-366

papers.title: Computational shielding of dengue viral prefusion with permeable cyclic-minipeptides
papers.abstract: Permeable cyclic-minipeptide-conformer candidates have been computationally cogenerated to shield the protected prefusionloops (FL) of dengue flavivirus (DENV). The objective was to prevent the pH-dependent dissociation events that trigger flavivirus fusion/ infectivity by exposing the FL highlyconserved sequences to homotrimer fusioncompetent conformations. For that, hundreds of BoltzGen candidates were co-generated targeting a prefusion minimized DENV envelope AB heterodimer (minEAB) model including both EA-protective and EB-FL sequences. The advantages of the newly cogenerated top-affinity nanoMolar candidates include possible bypassing of antibody-related enhancements, low antigenicity, easy chemical synthesis, and strong environmentalphysiological stability. Additionally, top-affinity parents were mutated to derive membranepermeable candidates conserving cyclization, minEAB targets and high-affinities. analysis.summary_en: This abstract describes a computational effort to design permeable cyclic‐minipeptide candidates that shield dengue virus prefusion loops, aiming to block pH‐triggered fusion. Hundreds of candidates were generated against a minimized DENV envelope model, and high‐affinity parents were mutated to retain target binding while gaining membrane permeability. The authors propose that these nanomolar‐affinity peptides could avoid antibody‐dependent enhancement, be low‐antigenic, synthetically accessible, and stable, offering a novel strategy for dengue inhibition. However, the report provides no experimental or quantitative results, limiting confidence in the findings and indicating that further in‐vitro and animal studies are needed to validate efficacy.

papers.title: Computational Identification of Dengue-Associated Comorbidities and Key Regulatory Genes from Peripheral Blood Mononuclear Cell Transcriptomes
papers.abstract: Dengue fever remains a major health concern, and variation in host immune responses contributes to differences in clinical severity. This study computationally investigated peripheral blood mononuclear cell (PBMC) transcriptomes to identify highly expressed sample-specific genes, potential dengue-associated comorbidities, and key regulatory genes across dengue fever, dengue haemorrhagic fever, dengue with plasma leakage, and dengue without plasma leakage. Publicly available RNA-seq datasets were collected, processed, and integrated. Highly expressed sample-specific genes were identified after excluding housekeeping genes, followed by Gene Ontology, KEGG pathway, and Disease Ontology enrichment analyses. Protein–protein interaction networks were then used to identify hub genes associated with enriched disease terms. The analyses identified BCL2, MYC, TNF, and TYMS as key genes linking the examined dengue conditions with distinct disease categories. Leukaemia-related disease terms were prominent in dengue fever and dengue haemorrhagic fever, with BCL2 identified in both conditions and MYC additionally identified in dengue haemorrhagic fever. In dengue with plasma leakage, TNF was associated with rheumatic and autoimmune disease terms. In dengue without plasma leakage, TNF was linked with rheumatic and tuberculosis-related terms, while TYMS was associated with multiple myeloma-related molecular patterns. These findings describe condition-specific gene–disease overlaps in PBMC transcriptomes and provide computational candidates for further investigation. Experimental and clinical validation is required before these predicted associations can be considered for diagnostic or therapeutic application.
papers.journal: Asian Journal of Research in Infectious Diseases

analysis.research_question_and_background: Dengue fever remains a major health concern, and variation in host immune responses contributes to differences in clinical severity. This study aimed to identify key regulatory genes and dengue-associated comorbidities through computational analysis of PBMC transcriptomes.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study computationally investigated peripheral blood mononuclear cell (PBMC) transcriptomes to identify highly expressed sample-specific genes, potential dengue-associated comorbidities, and key regulatory genes across dengue fever, dengue haemorrhagic fever, dengue with plasma leakage, and dengue without plasma leakage.
analysis.methods: Publicly available RNA-seq datasets were collected, processed, and integrated. Highly expressed sample-specific genes were identified after excluding housekeeping genes, followed by Gene Ontology, KEGG pathway, and Disease Ontology enrichment analyses. Protein–protein interaction networks were then used to identify hub genes associated with enriched disease terms.
analysis.main_results: The analyses identified BCL2, MYC, TNF, and TYMS as key genes linking the examined dengue conditions with distinct disease categories. Leukaemia-related disease terms were prominent in dengue fever and dengue haemorrhagic fever, with BCL2 identified in both conditions and MYC additionally identified in dengue haemorrhagic fever. In dengue with plasma leakage, TNF was associated with rheumatic and autoimmune disease terms. In dengue without plasma leakage, TNF was linked with rheumatic and tuberculosis-related terms, while TYMS was associated with multiple myeloma-related molecular patterns.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings describe condition-specific gene–disease overlaps in PBMC transcriptomes and provide computational candidates for further investigation.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings may inform future research on the molecular mechanisms underlying dengue disease progression and could contribute to the development of targeted diagnostic or therapeutic strategies.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is based on computational analysis of existing RNA-seq datasets, which may introduce biases or limitations in interpretation. The evidence strength is moderate due to the reliance on publicly available data without experimental validation.

analysis.summary_en: This study computationally analyzed PBMC transcriptomes to identify key regulatory genes and dengue-associated comorbidities across different dengue conditions. The research aimed to understand how host immune responses vary with clinical severity. By integrating RNA-seq datasets and performing enrichment analyses, the study found that genes such as BCL2, MYC, TNF, and TYMS are associated with distinct disease categories. These genes were linked to conditions like leukemia, rheumatic diseases, and tuberculosis. The findings highlight condition-specific gene-disease overlaps and offer potential targets for further investigation. However, the study's reliance on existing datasets without experimental validation limits its evidence strength, which is assessed as moderate. The results may inform future research on dengue disease mechanisms and contribute to the development of diagnostic or therapeutic strategies.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 登革热仍然是一个主要的健康问题,登革热中宿主 免疫应答的变异导致临床严重程度的差异。本研究旨在通过计算分析外周血单核细胞(PBMC)转录组,识别关键调控基因和登革热相关共病。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究通过计算分析外周血单核细胞(PBMC)转录组,以识别高表达的样本特异性基因、潜在的登革热相关共病以及登革热、登革热出血热、登革热伴血浆渗漏和登革热不伴血浆渗漏之间的关键调控基因。
elements_zh.methods: 收集、处理并整合了公开可用的RNA-seq数据集。在排除管家基因后,识别出高表达的样本特异性基因,并进行了基因本体(Gene Ontology)、KEGG通路和疾病本体(Disease Ontology)的富集分析。随后利用蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用网络识别与富集疾病术语相关的枢纽基因。
elements_zh.main_results: 分析结果显示,BCL2、MYC、TNF和TYMS是连接所研究的登革热状况与不同疾病类别的关键基因。与白血病相关的疾病术语在登革热和登革热出血热中尤为突出,其中BCL2在两种状况中均被识别,而MYC则在登革热出血热中被额外识别。在登革热伴血浆渗漏中,TNF与风湿性和自身免疫性疾病术语相关。在登革热不伴血浆渗漏中,TNF与风湿性和结核病相关术语相关,而TYMS则与多发性骨髓瘤相关的分子模式相关。

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: Dengue fever remains a major health concern, and variation in host immune responses contributes to differences in clinical severity. This study aimed to identify key regulatory genes and dengue-associated comorbidities through computational analysis of PBMC transcriptomes.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: The study computationally investigated peripheral blood mononuclear cell (PBMC) transcriptomes to identify highly expressed sample-specific genes, potential dengue-associated comorbidities, and key regulatory genes across dengue fever, dengue haemorrhagic fever, dengue with plasma leakage, and dengue without plasma leakage.
analysis_en.methods: Publicly available RNA-seq datasets were collected, processed, and integrated. Highly expressed sample-specific genes were identified after excluding housekeeping genes, followed by Gene Ontology, KEGG pathway, and Disease Ontology enrichment analyses. Protein–protein interaction networks were then used to identify hub genes associated with enriched disease terms.
analysis_en.main_results: The analyses identified BCL2, MYC, TNF, and TYMS as key genes linking the examined dengue conditions with distinct disease categories. Leukaemia-related disease terms were prominent in dengue fever and dengue haemorrhagic fever, with BCL2 identified in both conditions and MYC additionally identified in dengue haemorrhagic fever. In dengue with plasma leakage, TNF was associated with rheumatic and autoimmune disease terms. In dengue without plasma leakage, TNF was linked with rheumatic and tuberculosis-related terms, while TYMS was associated with multiple myeloma-related molecular patterns.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings describe condition-specific gene–disease overlaps in PBMC transcriptomes and provide computational candidates for further investigation.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings may inform future research on the molecular mechanisms underlying dengue disease progression and could contribute to the development of targeted diagnostic or therapeutic strategies.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is based on computational analysis of existing RNA-seq datasets, which may introduce biases or limitations in interpretation. The evidence strength is moderate due to the reliance on publicly available data without experimental validation.

papers.title_zh: 基于外周血单核细胞转录组的登革热相关共病及关键调控基因的计算识别
papers.source_body_en: Dengue fever remains a major health concern, and variation in host immune responses contributes to differences in clinical severity. This study computationally investigated peripheral blood mononuclear cell (PBMC) transcriptomes to identify highly expressed sample-specific genes, potential dengue-associated comorbidities, and key regulatory genes across dengue fever, dengue haemorrhagic fever, dengue with plasma leakage, and dengue without plasma leakage. Publicly available RNA-seq datasets were collected, processed, and integrated. Highly expressed sample-specific genes were identified after excluding housekeeping genes, followed by Gene Ontology, KEGG pathway, and Disease Ontology enrichment analyses. Protein–protein interaction networks were then used to identify hub genes associated with enriched disease terms. The analyses identified BCL2, MYC, TNF, and TYMS as key genes linking the examined dengue conditions with distinct disease categories. Leukaemia-related disease terms were prominent in dengue fever and dengue haemorrhagic fever, with BCL2 identified in both conditions and MYC additionally identified in dengue haemorrhagic fever. In dengue with plasma leakage, TNF was associated with rheumatic and autoimmune disease terms. In dengue without plasma leakage, TNF was linked with rheumatic and tuberculosis-related terms, while TYMS was associated with multiple myeloma-related molecular patterns. These findings describe condition-specific gene–disease overlaps in PBMC transcriptomes and provide computational candidates for further investigation. Experimental and clinical validation is required before these predicted associations can be considered for diagnostic or therapeutic application.

papers.title: Experiences of Dengue Patients and Healthcare Professionals in Public Hospitals of Rizal, Philippines
papers.abstract: Dengue is a disease that plagues the Philippines, and the experiences of dengue patients and healthcare workers in public hospitals in Rizal in response to the rising dengue cases remain to be further investigated. This study seeks to gather information through interviews with healthcare professionals and dengue patients from public hospitals in Rizal, Philippines to interpret and consider their experiences to improve the effectiveness, efficiency, and quality of treating dengue cases. A qualitative study was conducted through semi-structured interviews of three dengue patients and three healthcare workers obtained through snowball sampling. A thematic analysis was used to synthesize the data. It was found that patients had experiences with problems due to understaffing, difficult accommodations, and the lasting effects of the disease on their mental and physical health. Healthcare workers were shown to suffer from severe workload due to the high number of patients, difficulties communicating with patients, and insufficient facilities. This sheds light on the experiences of each group and the aspects of healthcare in public hospitals of Rizal that may be improved, such as budget allocation, creating more tertiary hospitals, improving work conditions of healthcare professionals, more efficient healthcare systems, and more. This aligns with the theoretical framework, showing the relationship between systemic availability and individual capability which negatively affect a patient’s and a healthcare worker’s journey.

papers.abstract_zh: 登革热是一种困扰菲律宾的疾病,菲律宾黎刹省(Rizal)公共医院中登革热患者和医护人员在应对登革热病例上升时的经历仍需进一步研究。本研究通过采访黎刹省公共医院的医疗专业人员和登革热患者,收集信息以解读和考虑他们的经历,从而提高登革热病例治疗的有效性、效率和质量。本研究采用定性研究方法,通过滚雪球抽样获取了三名登革热患者和三名医护人员的半结构化访谈数据,并采用主题分析法对数据进行综合。研究发现,患者经历了由于人员不足、住宿困难以及疾病对其心理和身体健康造成的长期影响等问题。医护人员则因患者数量众多、与患者沟通困难以及设施不足而面临严重的工作负担。这揭示了各群体的经历以及黎刹省公共医院在医疗方面可能需要改进的方面,例如预算分配、建立更多三级医院、改善医护人员的工作条件、建立更高效的医疗系统等。这与理论框架相一致,展示了系统可用性与个人能力之间的关系,这种关系对患者和医护人员的就医过程产生负面影响。

papers.title: Epidemiologia da dengue no Brasil, características gerais dessa doença tropical negligenciada e a vacinação como forma de prevenção
papers.abstract: A dengue é uma arbovirose incluída na lista de doenças tropicais negligenciadas da Organização Mundial da Saúde, com impacto relevante para a saúde pública. O presente estudo teve como objetivo descrever os aspectos gerais da dengue, o uso da vacinação como forma de prevenção e apresentar a sua situação epidemiológica no Brasil. Trata-se de uma revisão narrativa da literatura, realizada a partir da busca de artigos publicados entre 2014 e 2025 nas bases de dados PubMed, LILACS e SciELO. O vírus da dengue (DENV) pertence ao gênero Flavivirus e possui quatro sorotipos distintos. A doença apresenta amplo espectro clínico, variando de formas assintomáticas a quadros graves e fatais. Em geral, é importante destacar o papel relevante do tratamento de suporte, das ações de controle vetorial e prevenção, do diagnóstico oportuno e da vacinação como estratégia complementar. Em relação a epidemiologia no Brasil, ressalta-se que em 2024 foram registrados 6,4 milhões de casos prováveis e mais de 5.000 óbitos, em cenário de circulação dos quatro sorotipos, com elevada carga e repercussões clínicas, sociais e econômicas. Experiências com a abordagem One Health (Saúde Única) reforçam a importância da integração entre dimensões humanas, ambientais e vetoriais no enfrentamento da doença. Por fim, evidencia-se que a dengue é uma condição complexa, exigindo manejo clínico adequado, vigilância sensível, controle vetorial, vacinação guiada por critérios epidemiológicos e adoção da abordagem One Health como eixos complementares para reduzir sua carga e orientar políticas sustentáveis.

analysis.summary_en: This study provides an overview of dengue in Brazil, emphasizing its status as a neglected tropical disease and the role of vaccination in prevention. It outlines the general characteristics of dengue, including its classification as a Flavivirus with four distinct serotypes. The research highlights the wide clinical spectrum of the disease, ranging from asymptomatic cases to severe and fatal outcomes. The authors stress the importance of supportive treatment, vector control, timely diagnosis, and vaccination as complementary strategies. They also note the significant epidemiological burden in Brazil in 2024, with over 6.4 million probable cases and more than 5,000 deaths. The study advocates for the integration of human, environmental, and vector dimensions through the One Health approach to reduce the disease's impact. However, the findings are based on a literature review and do not include detailed statistical or methodological analysis.

papers.title: Shared Learning for Nationwide Municipal Dengue Incidence Forecasting in Brazil: Evidence on History, Climate, and Model Trade-Offs
papers.abstract: Municipality-level dengue forecasting is challenging because each time series is short. Additional predictors also do not always provide useful information. We evaluated one-month-ahead monthly incidence across all 5,570 Brazilian municipalities. The evaluation used 60 rolling targets and history windows of 12–48 months. We first used a 50-municipality diagnostic sample to test history, shared versus local learning, additional information, and neural models. We then conducted nationwide internal validation. In the diagnostic sample, the shared gated recurrent unit (GRU) reduced pooled MAE by 23.0%–24.5% compared with municipality-specific GRUs. Climate improved local LightGBM (MAE, 3.9%–5.1%; RMSE, 10.3%–11.5%). However, climate increased the shared GRU’s MAE. The predictive value of climate therefore depended on the model. Nationwide, the history-only shared GRU had the lowest RMSE at every lookback. An adaptive ensemble slightly improved MAE but increased RMSE.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to address the challenge of municipality-level dengue forecasting, which is difficult due to the short duration of each time series. The research sought to evaluate the effectiveness of using shared learning models for predicting dengue incidence across Brazil.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study evaluated one-month-ahead monthly incidence across all 5,570 Brazilian municipalities. It used a 50-municipality diagnostic sample to test various factors, including history, shared versus local learning, additional information, and neural models, followed by nationwide internal validation.
analysis.methods: The evaluation used 60 rolling targets and history windows of 12–48 months. The study first tested models on a 50-municipality diagnostic sample and then conducted nationwide internal validation to assess their performance.
analysis.main_results: In the diagnostic sample, the shared gated recurrent unit (GRU) reduced pooled MAE by 23.0%–24.5% compared with municipality-specific GRUs. However, climate increased the shared GRU’s MAE. The predictive value of climate therefore depended on the model. Nationwide, the history-only shared GRU had the lowest RMSE at every lookback. An adaptive ensemble slightly improved MAE but increased RMSE.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted that the shared GRU model showed significant improvement in accuracy when compared to local models, but the inclusion of climate data had varying effects depending on the model type. This finding highlights the importance of model selection in incorporating climate data for dengue forecasting.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform the development of more accurate dengue forecasting models that leverage shared learning across municipalities, potentially improving public health preparedness and resource allocation in Brazil.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to an abstract-only analysis, and the evidence is based on internal validation without external comparisons. The confidence in the findings is moderate due to the lack of detailed statistical analysis and potential biases in the diagnostic sample.

analysis.summary_en: This study addresses the challenge of dengue forecasting at the municipality level in Brazil, where time series data are often short. The research evaluates the effectiveness of shared learning models in predicting dengue incidence across all 5,570 municipalities. Using a 50-municipality diagnostic sample, the study tests the impact of history, shared versus local learning, additional information, and neural models. The results show that shared gated recurrent unit (GRU) models reduced pooled mean absolute error (MAE) by 23.0%–24.5% compared to municipality-specific GRUs, but climate data increased MAE in shared models. The predictive value of climate data was found to depend on the model type. Nationwide, the history-only shared GRU had the lowest root mean square error (RMSE) at every lookback, while an adaptive ensemble slightly improved MAE but increased RMSE. The authors interpret these findings as highlighting the importance of model selection when incorporating climate data for dengue forecasting. The study's results can inform the development of more accurate forecasting models, which may improve public health preparedness. However, the evidence is based on internal validation and is limited to an abstract-only analysis, which may affect the confidence in the findings.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在解决城市层面登革热预测的挑战,该挑战由于每个时间序列的持续时间较短而变得困难。研究旨在评估使用共享学习模型预测巴西全国登革热的有效性。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究评估了巴西所有5,570个城市每月的登革热预测。它使用了一个50个城市的诊断样本,测试了包括历史数据、共享学习与本地学习、额外信息以及神经网络模型在内的各种因素,随后进行了全国范围内的内部验证。
elements_zh.methods: 评估使用了60个滚动目标和12至48个月的历史窗口。研究首先在50个城市的诊断样本上测试了模型,然后进行了全国范围内的内部验证以评估其性能。
elements_zh.main_results: 在诊断样本中,共享门控循环单元(GRU)模型相比城市特定的GRU模型,将综合平均绝对误差(MAE)降低了23.0%–24.5%。然而,气候因素增加了共享GRU模型的MAE。因此,气候因素的预测价值取决于所使用的模型。在全国范围内,仅使用历史数据的共享GRU模型在每个回溯周期中均具有最低的均方根误差(RMSE)。一个自适应集成模型略微提高了MAE,但增加了RMSE。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者认为,共享GRU模型在与本地模型相比时显示出显著的准确性提升,但气候数据的纳入对不同模型类型的影响各不相同。这一发现强调了在登革热预测中结合气候数据时选择合适模型的重要性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为开发更准确的登革热预测模型提供信息,这些模型利用城市间的共享学习,可能有助于提高巴西的公共卫生准备能力和资源分配效率。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究仅限于对摘要的分析,证据基于内部验证,而没有外部比较。由于缺乏详细的统计分析和诊断样本中可能存在的偏倚,研究结果的可信度中等。

analysis_zh.main_results: 在诊断样本中,共享门控循环单元(GRU)模型相比城市特定的GRU模型,将综合平均绝对误差(MAE)降低了23.0%–24.5%。然而,气候因素增加了共享GRU模型的MAE。因此,气候因素的预测价值取决于所使用的模型。在全国范围内,仅使用历史数据的共享GRU模型在每个回溯周期中均具有最低的均方根误差(RMSE)。一个自适应集成模型略微提高了MAE,但增加了RMSE。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者认为,共享GRU模型在与本地模型相比时显示出显著的准确性提升,但气候数据的纳入对不同模型类型的影响各不相同。这一发现强调了在登革热预测中结合气候数据时选择合适模型的重要性。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为开发更准确的登革热预测模型提供信息,这些模型利用城市间的共享学习,可能有助于提高巴西的公共卫生准备能力和资源分配效率。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究仅限于对摘要的分析,证据基于内部验证,而没有外部比较。由于缺乏详细的统计分析和诊断样本中可能存在的偏倚,研究结果的可信度中等。

papers.title: A dengue sob uma perspectiva epidemiológica e sociodemográfica: uma análise sobre o estado de Minas Gerais
papers.abstract: O contexto epidemiológico da dengue no Brasil caracteriza-se por oscilações entre períodos endêmicos e surtos epidêmicos, representando um desafio contínuo à saúde pública. Este estudo tem como objetivo geral analisar o perfil epidemiológico e sociodemográfico da dengue no estado de Minas Gerais, com ênfase no município de Uberlândia, a partir de evidências da literatura científica recente. Trata-se de uma pesquisa bibliográfica, de caráter descritivo e exploratório, realizada em bases de dados nacionais e internacionais. Os resultados indicam elevada incidência da doença em determinados períodos do ano, forte associação com fatores socioambientais, desigualdades regionais e impacto significativo sobre o Sistema Único de Saúde. Conclui-se que a dengue permanece como um importante problema de saúde pública em Minas Gerais, exigindo estratégias integradas de vigilância epidemiológica, controle vetorial e ações intersetoriais.

Este estudo tem como objetivo geral analisar o perfil epidemiológico e sociodemográfico da dengue no estado de Minas Gerais, com ênfase no município de Uberlândia, a partir de evidências da literatura científica recente. Trata-se de uma pesquisa bibliográfica, de caráter descritivo e exploratório, realizada em bases de dados nacionais e internacionais. Os resultados indicam elevada incidência da doença em determinados períodos do ano, forte associação com fatores socioambientais, desigualdades regionais e impacto significativo sobre o Sistema Único de Saúde. Conclui-se que a dengue permanece como um importante problema de saúde pública em Minas Gerais, exigindo estratégias integradas de vigilância epidemiológica, controle vetorial e ações intersetoriais.

analysis.study_design_and_population: This is a descriptive and exploratory bibliographic research conducted using national and international databases to analyze the epidemiological and sociodemographic profile of dengue in Minas Gerais, focusing on Uberlândia.
analysis.methods: The study employed a descriptive and exploratory bibliographic research approach, utilizing national and international databases to gather and analyze recent scientific evidence on dengue.
analysis.main_results: The results indicate a high incidence of dengue during certain periods of the year, a strong association with socio-environmental factors, regional inequalities, and a significant impact on the Unified Health System.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret that dengue remains a significant public health problem in Minas Gerais, requiring integrated strategies for epidemiological surveillance, vector control, and intersectoral actions.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings inform the need for integrated surveillance and control strategies, highlighting the importance of addressing socio-environmental factors and regional inequalities to mitigate dengue's impact on the health system.

analysis.summary_en: This study analyzes the epidemiological and sociodemographic profile of dengue in Minas Gerais, focusing on Uberlândia, through a descriptive and exploratory bibliographic review of recent scientific evidence. The research reveals high seasonal incidence of dengue, strong associations with socio-environmental factors, regional disparities, and significant impacts on the Unified Health System. The authors conclude that dengue remains a major public health challenge in the region, necessitating integrated approaches to surveillance, vector control, and intersectoral interventions. While the study's bibliographic nature limits its scope, the use of current scientific evidence provides moderate confidence in its conclusions and recommendations for addressing dengue's multifaceted challenges.

papers.title: Scorpion Peptides in Antiviral Drug Discovery: An In-depth Review.
papers.abstract: Despite remarkable progress in the fields of vaccinology and antiviral therapy, viral infections persist as a leading cause of morbidity and mortality worldwide. Therefore, it is crucial to identify new and effective antiviral drug candidates. Scorpion venoms are viewed as a rich source of structurally diverse and biologically active peptides, which may present opportunities for diagnostic, preventive, and therapeutic applications. This review intends to provide a contemporary and detailed analysis of scorpion-derived peptides, with a particular focus on their structural diversity, cytotoxic effects, antiviral properties, and mechanisms of action. Additionally, this paper highlights several potential fruitful areas for future studies. Current evidence indicates that scorpion-derived peptides are effective against a wide array of medically important viral pathogens such as chikungunya virus, dengue virus, enterovirus 71, hepatitis B virus (HBV), herpes simplex virus 1, human immunodeficiency virus 1, influenza A virus (IAV), severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus-2, and Zika virus. Nevertheless, the majority of these findings have been obtained from in vitro studies, whereas evidence from animal models remains limited and clinical evaluation in humans is currently unavailable. Available studies suggest that these peptides may act through diverse mechanisms of action, including direct virucidal activity, inhibition of viral entry, immune system modulation, reduction of virus-induced cytopathic effects, and suppression of viral gene expression. Emerging evidence also demonstrates the efficacy of certain scorpion-derived peptides in animal models of HBV, IAV, and Newcastle disease virus infection. Overall, such peptides appear to inaugurate new avenues for the treatment of viral infections.
